Attention Chasers!

Maintenance will happen during the following times:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/adfb7f80d4244c368ea827d1fe6a824d605617b0.png

1. Tournament System (Beta)

■ Period: June 7, 2023 After Maintenance - Permanent
With the opening of the new tournament system, the tournament will open daily at 13:00 (UTC+0). The pairings will be automatically made and the tournament will continue until a winner is singled out. The matches will be carried out as 2 vs 2 Deathmatch with a 10-minute timer. If 10 minutes have passed, the team with higher remaining HP will win. If both teams have the same remaining HP, the team that accumulated more damage dealt will win. Since this is up for beta testing, the system may be unstable.

■ Tournament Beta Test Time
Every day at 13:00 (UTC+0)

■ Tournament Process
1) Tournament Mission Card Entry
When it is time for the Tournament, an announcement will be made that the tournament is open.
Players can enter Tournament UI by pressing on the Mission UI (Hotkey: M) and going over to the Tournament Mission Card.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/35aa319b9a614c885f239abc7e07e3bb2455e7af.jpg
2) Register for Tournament
Player can press on the Register for Tournament button to participate in the tournament.
If the player has a friend they wish to play with, they can form a party to register. The player could also queue alone. Tournament Registration will be open for 15 minutes. Players may practice in the Training Ground or play other missions. However, players must be in Eltheca before the registration period is over.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ea5cb32f9b752c81c37673c2c87da85071c34402.jpg
3) Confirm Tournament Participation
When the registration period is over, the player will be asked if they really want to participate in the tournament. Press Participate to continue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/6b9239740a63c1b6fe8baf6f50a6b6cc49285921.jpg
4) Bracket Stage
If you successfully participate in the tournament, you will receive a participation success message along with the bracket setup.
If you lack team members, you will be matched with a party member at similar skill levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/18974d0e4eca6b547c37979c07f6316f4645a1a9.jpg
5) Match Progress
After the brackets have been set up, matches will be in progress.
Winning will set up the next set of brackets.
The teams that finish faster will move onto the next match.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/840cfec84009bd6db4bde257fbbf92763e317550.jpg
6) Winner Decided
When the winner of the tournament is decided, a server-wide announcement will be made to announce the winner of the tournament with the highest rank. The winner will have a trophy icon next to their rank to signify their victory. Trophy icon will be retained until a winner is decided for the next tournament.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/208c5b01f68c44fe2798c929e04d460c01bbc16a.jpg

■ Period: June 7, 2023 After Maintenance - Permanent

notes.title: Login Issue with Latest Steam Version (ver.1682538895)
notes.notes:
Hello Chasers!

Please update to the latest Steam client as of now to resolve Steam API Authentication issue.

There is an ongoing login issue with the latest Steam version (ver.1682538895) due to an error with the API Authentication.

Players who have downloaded and updated their client to the latest patch will encounter "Failed to verify account (ErrorCode: 285)" in their Login Screen, preventing them from logging in.

This issue is happening not only with KurtzPel, but across the entire Steam platform for games that use API Authentication.

We have noticed that Steam API Authorization will go through after a set period of time. For those who have already updated the Steam client, please leave the client on for 30 minutes or more before turning on KurtzPel.

We recommend players who have updated their Steam Client to attempt the abovementioned method and those who have not updated to wait until the latest version is stabilized.

We will continue to strive to minimize any inconvenience that may arise in our service.

Thank you,

notes.title: September 28th, 2022 Weekly Maintenance Patch Notes
notes.notes:
# New Karma 
Radiant Horn
- Weapon: Lance
- Type: Melee Breaker 
Radiant Horn is a Karma that uses Lance. Adept at closing Gaps and quick assaults, Radiant Horn can break the enemy’s armor to deal heavy damage.

# Event
Radiant Horn Release Event
Event Period: 09-28-2022 (Wed) After Maintenance – 10-19-2022 (Wed) 05:00 (UTC+0)

# Karma Balance (PVP)
Blazing Fist
[Whirlwind]
- Increased movement speed by 50% while casting
- Increased charge distance by 20% 
- Increased break damage of grab attack by 35%
- Reduced break damage of grab failure action by 40%
[Reckless Charge]
- Increased break damage of charge by 100%
- Reduced break damage of grab failure action by 40% 

Dual Soul
[Wolf Fang]
- Increased break damage by 100%
- Increased damage by 25% 
- Reduced time to allow movement after use by 0.1 seconds
- Reduced the push on enemies hit by 54%
- Increased the power to launch enemies in the air by 23%
- Increased the stun time by 0.07 seconds
[Destiny’s Restraints]
- Increased the damage of slash attack by 100%

Aegis Knight
[Shield Throw]
- Increased break damage of 1st attack by 100% 
[Battlecry]
- Increased movement speed by 25% while casting
[Defend] (RMB Charging)
- Changed so that players can use Defense Attack by using left click while charging with right click 
(Defense Attack deals more damage and break damage depending on the time charged.)
- Changed so that skill can be used while charging (right click) 

Lightning Fang
[Flame Strike]
- Increased damage by 10%
[Lightning Storm]
- Reduced damage by 15%
[Lightning Drop]
- Reduced damage by 10%
[Demon Blade Unleashed]
- Reduced duration by 5 seconds

# UI Improvements
- Improved UI with an increased number of Karmas 
Karma UI will be improved with the increase in the number of Karmas  
Karma description and list now categorizes Karmas into Breaker / Slayer / Melee / Ranged categories. 

Improved KP Shop Package Preview
If the package has items of same categories, the preview will allow both items to be seen one after the other. 

- Improved KP Shop Character Preview
Improved certain character Hair and Weapon to display full image through preview

- Added a new function to hide KP Shop Hair
Improved so that tail hair and side hair can be hidden in preview 

- Improved Supply Box Open Window and KP Shop Supply Box Preview Window
Improved Supply Box Open Window and KP Shop Supply Box Preview Window to retain Costume Preview so that players can try out the full set costume.
 

# Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where items previewed in Synthesis UI can also be seen in Trading Post preview.
- Fixed a bug where using Fallen Light – Ice Trap displayed abnormal images in the bullets
- Fixed a bug where using Tab + Chase on the ground displaced the player abnormally far from the enemy with certain Karma combinations

KurtzPel Team

The current PVP season in progress will be retained.

- Players will be able to select ‘Korean’ as their text language.

[Character Names]
- Non-duplicate character names can be used as they are now.

- Duplicate character names will appear to have their server code attached until their character names are changed.

[Guild]
- Non-duplicate guild names can be used as they are now.
- Guild names that were non-duplicate in the previous merge but will be duplicated in the merge with Korean servers will have the global code (#GB) attached to the end of the guild names after the merge. (Ex: KurtzPel#GB)
- Guild names with the server code attached will have 1 chance to change their names.
- Guild names with the server code attached will require the server code when searching for guilds.

- After the merge, rank/ranking will be recalculated with the Korean players combined. Previous season ranks can be checked on ‘Stone of Honor’ by the server.

Event Period: 2022-08-03 After Maintenance – 2022-08-17 05:00 (UTC+0)

- Players can now report griefing, use of unapproved third-party programs, cheating/bug abuse, fraud, inappropriate character names, etc. much easier than before.

1. Server Merge
During 2022-06-21 Maintenance (UTC+0), America, Europe, and Asia servers will be merged. We had separated the servers for smooth gameplay. We are merging the servers so that players can interact and communicate with more Chasers.
In the merged server, players can communicate with Chasers from other servers only in Eltheca. In the PVP / PVE gameplay, players will be matched with only other players of similar ping to retain the quality of gameplay.

[System]
- After the server merge, server time will be calculated based on UTC+0.
- All content reset time (quest, invasion, etc.) will be based on UTC+0.
- Players can check previous season rankings for each server in Stone of Honor.
- All options will be set to default on server merge.

[Character]
- All characters within the account will be moved to a merged server. Character slots will be merged according to the number of characters and empty character slots in each server.
- Character names will be merged. Non-duplicate character names will be merged. Duplicate character names will be changed to ‘Name#ServerCode. (Ex: KurtzPel#AM, KurtzPel#EU, KurtzPel#AS)
Character names with server code will require the full name including the server code to be typed for whispers and custom missions.
- Characters that have done tutorial before the merge will have counted as they have done tutorial after the merge.
- Karma Level will also be merged. Karma Level will be determined by adding all AP per Karma per server. All additional progression boxes and unclaimed boxes due to the newly determined level will be sent to the KP inventory as items. (Since the level is re-calculated using AP, the level may appear lower than before.)
- If players have different unlocked Karmas in different servers, they will be able to use all Karmas in their account upon server merge.
- If two or more characters are unlocking the same Karma through normal unlock, the accumulated AP will be merged and saved. The normal unlock progression will be stopped. Players will need to click on normal unlock again after the server merge to continue their progression on opening their Karma.
- Quest progression will be merged. However, all incomplete quests and quests that have not hit the complete button will be reset. Please complete the quests before the maintenance.
- Normal Dungeon and Abyss progression will be merged to the server with the furthest progression.
- All character ranks and ratings will be retained.

[Currency and Item]
- GP and KP will be merged respectively across the server. Items in the KP inventory will be merged.
- Items in the character’s mail will be moved along with the server merge. The expiration date for all items in the mail will be extended by 1 day.
- Limited time costumes, limited time items, limited time emotes, and other items with limited time will be retained and extended by 1 day.
- All items on the trading post will be taken down upon server merge. All items will be sent to the players’ mail along with the trading post fee.
- Customization including but not limited to hair and odd-eye that had been unlocked will be merged along with the server merge.

[Community]
- Duplicate guild names will be changed to the following format: [GuildName#ServerCode]. Changed guild names will require the full name including the server code to be searched. notes.notes:
1.	New PVP Map – Elpida Island
-	A new PVP map – Elpida Island – will be added. Elpida Island can be played in the survival mode
 
 
 
 
2.	Team Survival
-	Team Survival will be added. In Team Survival, 10 teams will compete on Elpida Island. The following information pertains to the new mode: Team Survival.

[2 Player Team]
Unlike the original Survival Mode, 2 players will team up to play in this mode. Teamplay will be crucial in this mode. Even if one member is knocked out, the other member can resurrect the knocked-out teammate manually. Players will not be able to manually resurrect their teammates after 30 seconds.

[Minimap]
A minimap has been added to display the location of teammates and the Safe Zone.

[Free Movement Between Areas]
Elpida Island allows free movement between areas.
Unlike the original Survival Mode, where narrow passages connected each area, all areas will be connected with no barriers between the areas. 

[Buff Rank Expansion]
Players can now acquire buffs to enhance their buff up to rank 3.

[Slay Enemies to Gain Buffs]
When players slay an enemy, all the buffs the enemy has gained and buffs that recover resources will drop.
Heroic buffs may drop on a low chance. 

[Random Safe Zone Relocation]
Unlike the original Survival Mode, where the center of the Safe Zone was fixed at a point from start to end, Safe Zone will relocate to random locations every time its radius decreases, creating more variables within the game.

- Team Survival will be added. In Team Survival, 10 teams will compete on Elpida Island. The following information pertains to the new mode: Team Survival.

[2 Player Team]
Unlike the original Survival Mode, 2 players will team up to play in this mode. Teamplay will be crucial in this mode. Even if one member is knocked out, the other member can resurrect the knocked-out teammate manually. Players will not be able to manually resurrect their teammates after 30 seconds.

[Minimap]
A minimap has been added to display the location of teammates and the Safe Zone.

[Free Movement Between Areas]
Elpida Island allows free movement between areas.
Unlike the original Survival Mode, where narrow passages connected each area, all areas will be connected with no barriers between the areas. 

[Buff Rank Expansion]
Players can now acquire buffs to enhance their buff up to rank 3.

[Slay Enemies to Gain Buffs]
When players slay an enemy, all the buffs the enemy has gained and buffs that recover resources will drop. Heroic buffs may drop on a low chance. 

[Random Safe Zone Relocation]
Unlike the original Survival Mode, where the center of the Safe Zone was fixed at a point from start to end, Safe Zone will relocate to random locations every time its radius decreases, creating more variables within the game.

notes.title: April 27th 2022 Weekly Maintenance Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1.	Season 12 (End of Season 11)
-	Season 11 will end on April 27th, 2022, and Season 12 will begin. Season 11 Rank and Season Pass Rewards can be claimed until the end of Season 12. Please claim these rewards before Season 12 ends.
-	There will be a soft reset once Season 11 ends. The player’s Rank (Rating) for the new season will be determined once the player completes Rank Placement Matches. Rank placement will reflect the Rating from the previous season if the player has a Rating from the previous season.

2.	Rank / Matchmaking System Revamp
Rank and Matchmaking System will be revamped starting from Season 12.
-	Changed Rank to be determined by Rating
-	Simplified Rank
-	Added Rank Placement Matches
-	Changed to allow all players to check their rating
-	Added Normal Matches (2vs2)
-	Improved alternate character Rank & Rating calculation
-	Changed Rank rewards to be based on Rank at the end of the season
-	Capture the Flag will be removed from Ranked Matches (2vs2). Deathmatch will be the only mode available in Ranked Matches (2vs2). 
-	2vs2 and 4vs4 Event Battle modes that could be played every 2 weeks will be deleted. Emote cubes earned from completing quests for Event Battles can now be acquired through completing Weekly Battle Mission Quests.
-	Emote Random Cube will reward one of the below Emotes with equal rates.
-	Content: Crab Legs, Shuffle, Forgive Me!, Love You, T Pose, Mime, Pop & Lock, Sad, Like, Lit, Dark Meditation, and Salute. 
-	Normal Matches (2vs2) consists of Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, and Conquest.
-	Improvements to Rating Management Prevention

Season 11
Rank S: if 3 days pass since last Ranked Match: -50 points per day
Rank M, G: if 3 days pass since last Ranked Match: -100 points per day
 
Season 12
Rank S: if 7 days pass since last Ranked Match: -30 points per day (up to 10 days)
Rank M, G: if 7 days pass since last Ranked Match: -50 points per day (up to 10 days) 

*Rating will not be reduced below 1500 from Rating Management Prevention.
*Last Ranked Match will be checked daily at 10:00 AM (Server Time)
 
-	TOP 10 Rewards
Players' rank will be displayed above their head in Eltheca for all players currently within top 10 rank out of all chasers. Also, all top 10 players at the end of season will acquire TOP 10 Profile and Title.

* Top 10 Profile and Title will only be given to players with S Rank or higher.

For more information regarding changes brought to the rank and matchmaking system, please check out more details below:
[Announcement] Changes to Rank and Matchmaking in New Season:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/844870/view/3178986769798033369

3.	Changes to Battle System
-	Players will no longer need to hold the evade key to activate Mana Evade. Mana Evade will activate instantly upon pressing the designated key or can be activated by pressing [Space].

-	Players can queue into Normal or Hard difficulty based on the players’ Rank. Boss’ attack patterns, Boss’ HP, and the amount of rewards will be based on the difficulty. 
-	PVE equipment stats are not applied in raid dungeons. Players cannot use HP Potions, but Resurrection Stones and MP Potions can be used.
-	Players will not be able to queue into the raid as a party.
-	Players will receive 3 free entries every day. The number of free entries will reset at 10:00 AM (Server Time). Additional entry tickets can be purchased in the KP Shop. Synthesize special costume aura items using Apostle of Greed’s Lost Piece acquired through clearing raids.

notes.title: [Announcement] Changes to Rank and Matchmaking in New Season
notes.notes:
Hello Chasers,

We will be moving into the new season on April 27th. With the arrival of the new season, we’ll be guiding you through couple of changes that are brought to the rank and matchmaking system.

Rank Determined by Rating
In order for rank to properly portray the level of skill, your rating will now determine your rank. The ranks S, M, and G will be decided by rating instead players’ placement on the ranking board. The players with the highest rankings will be in the Rank UI in Eltheca.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ba7580102870295955c8f1abcaae54b77640aed0.png

Promo Matches Eliminated
Since rank will be determined by rating, the current promo matches will be eliminated.

Rank Simplified
In order to reduce the fluctuation of rank due to changes in rating from winning or losing, the rank system will be simplified.
- Rank will no longer be sub-divided into 3 sub-ranks. It will be combined into 1 rank.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/54e2eda2e14eaf694266429f7db1c841829e3305.png

Rank Placement System Added
A rank placement system will be added so that players can be quickly placed into ranks that reflect their skill level.
When players create a new character or when the new season begins, there will be 5 rank placement matches.
Once players complete all 5 matches, they will be placed into the starting rank for that season.

Rating Revealed for Everyone
Once you complete your rank placement, you can check your own rating.
In the past, only the players in A rank and higher could check their rating. This feature will be available for everyone who completed their rank placement.
After every ranked match, players will be able to check their increased/decreased rating.

Improved Matchmaking System
The matchmaking range expansion will be improved to match players of similar skill levels.
The range of matchmaking will expand differently depending on your rating, so players will more likely match against other players of similar skill levels

Party Play (Duo Queues) Disabled in Ranked Matches
Party play will be disabled in Ranked matches.
Since Kurtzpel Ranked Match is based on 2vs2, we believe communication and teamwork are large factors in determining victory and pre-formed parties have a natural advantage in these factors.
Adjusting the rating and matchmaking range was not enough to overcome these factors, so we have decided to limit party plays in ranked matches. We are very regretful to make this announcement, as we believed solo queues and duo queues playing together in a fair and free setting is ideal. We will make sure to consider different variables and improvements in hopes to incorporate party play back into the game.

Normal Match (2vs2) Added
Normal Match (2vs2) free of rating and rank will be added.
We expect Ranked Matches will have bigger pressure on players, with rating determining the rank and party plays being disabled. Normal Match (2vs2) mode is added in hopes to relieve this pressure. 
Normal Match (2vs2) offers quick matching to match players on a wider range of skill levels than ranked matches. 

Improvements to Prevent Rating Management
There is a system in place to prevent rating management, where players stop playing Ranked Matches in order to manage their rating. However, this applies a large pressure on certain players and leads to certain players getting matched with a large gap in skill due to their ratings dropping by a large margin.
We’ve decided to alleviate this by giving players more time before the rating deduction takes place and reducing the maximum deduction cap in their rating once their accounts are marked inactive.

Changes to Season Rewards
In the past, we gave out rewards based on the highest rank reached in the season.
This was to alleviate the pressure in managing ranks during the season. However, when some players reached a certain rank, they became unmotivated to play, causing other players to be frustrated.
Starting from next season, season rewards will give rewards based on the current rank at the end of the season.

Changes to Rating on Alternate Characters under the Same Account
When players of higher skill levels created alternate characters, they were matched with players of lower skill levels, causing unexpected harm to players of lower skill levels.
In the next season, alternate characters upon creation will be given a rating based on the character with the highest rating in that account.

notes.title: January 26th 2022 Weekly Maintenance Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1.	Season 11 (End of Season 10)
Season 10 will come to an end on UTC+0 2022 January 26th (Wed) maintenance.
Your rating will be soft reset once Season 10 ends and your new rank will be applied with Season 11.
Season 10’s rank rewards can be claimed until the end of Season 11.
Make sure to claim your unclaimed rewards before season 11 ends.

Rank Soft Reset
Your Season 11 rank will depend on your rank from Season 10.
All ranks will go down by 3.
The highest rank you can get from the reset is B1 and the lowest is D1.
However, all E ranks will be reset to E1.

2.	Karma Balance
[Sword Taliah]
Land Demolisher
-	Reduced the initial delay of attack by 40%
-	Removed the direct hit damage of the weapon
-	Reduced the mana cost of the 2nd attack by 50%

[Dance of Wind]
Siege Mode
-	Increased the damage by 30%
-	Reduced the mana cost when attacking by 20%

[Diabolic Witch]
Lightning
-	Reduced the initial delay of 1st attack by 62.5%/2nd attack by 76%/3rd attack by 23%
Blizzard
-	Reduced the max duration by 50%
Mana Ray
-	Reduced the max duration by 25%
-	Reduced the time it takes to get to the max level by 50%
-	Players can move while using the skill
[Blazing Fist]	
Wild Flurry
-	Skill animation cancel with the movement key is 20% faster
-	Increased the last attack’s launch distance by 30%/Reduced the last attack’s knockback distance by 50%
-  Increased the auto target range by 60%

[Dual Soul]
Wolf Fang
-	Increased the damage by 100%
-	Increased the attack speed by 25%
-	Increased the launch distance by 50%/Reduced the knockback distance by 50%
-	Increased the projectile speed by 20%
-	Reduced the projectile duration by 53%
-	Increased the Auto targeting range by 53%

[Sacred Guardian]
Sanctuary
-   Added Break damage to hit and knock back enemies
-	Skill animation cancel with the movement key is 20% faster
Ultimate Swing
-	Increased the damage by 20%
-	Changed it to be a single strike

[Fallen Light]
Lightning Shot
-	Increased the damage by 40%
-	Increased the projectile speed by 40%

[Ruler of Darkness]
Dark Mist
-	Increased the invincibility duration by 50%
-	Players can immediately attack during invincibility by pressing LMB
Demon Rush
-	Increased the damage by 15%
Dimension Cutter
-	Increased the damage by 30%

[Soul of Magus]
Star Tempest
-	Reduced the initial delay of projectile spawn by 50%
-	Reduced the initial delay of projectile attack by 31%
-	Increased the auto target range by 85%
-	Increased the launch distance by 50%

[Aegis Knight]
Charge
-	Players can evade while charging
-	Increased the launch distance by 20%

[Crimson Lily]
Slice and Dice
-	Evading while using the skill is 20% faster
[Desperado]
Aimed Shot
-	Increased the skill damage by 100% (Uncharged)
Throw Explosives
-	Increased the damage by 50%

Reduced the range of some Melee Breaker skills that had longer ranges, so that every skill has a similar range.

[Sword Taliah]
Fragment Strike
-	Reduced the range by 14%
Land Demolisher
-	Reduced the range by 14%
Leap
-	Reduced the range by 11%
[Blazing Fist]
		Instant Chase
-	Increased the range by 6%
[Sacred Guardian]
		Holy Cross
-	Reduced the range by 25%
Sanctuary
-	Reduced the range by 33%
[Ruler of Darkness]
Demon Rush
-	Reduced the range by 15%
Death Hold
-	Reduced the range by 25%
Rising Wings
-	Reduced the range by 6%
RMB (Including in air)
-	Reduced the range by 20%
Evade Attack
-	Reduced the range by 25%
[Aegis Knight]
		Shield Throw
-	Reduced the range by 24%
Shield Pull
-	Reduced the range by 2%
[Crimson Lily]
		Slice and Dice
-	Reduced the range by 11%

Other Changes
[Sword Taliah]
RMB Charge (Level 2,3)
- Launch the enemy in close proximity

[All]
Wall Jump
- Reduced the pushback distance when jumping against the wall


3.	New Map - Proving Grounds (Deathmatch)
A new PVP map will be added. Proving Grounds will appear in 2 vs 2 Ranked Matches.

  

4.	Event Mode - Destruction 

 
Previous event mode Capture the Flag will end, and Destruction will be applied for the new event mode.
- ‘Play Event Battle Mission’ will be added to the weekly quest which will reward ‘Emote Random Cube’.
-Emote Random Cube will reward one of the below Emotes with equal rates.
- Content: Crab Legs, Shuffle, Forgive Me!, Love You, T Pose, Mime, Pop & Lock, Sad, Like, Lit, Dark Meditation, and Salute. 

5.	New Player Guide Improvements
We improved the New Player Guide so that the new Chasers can get used to Eltheca better.
-	Normal Match, Ranked Match, and some missions will have level restrictions.
-	UI that can be closed by pressing the ESC key can be closed by pressing the X button.
Other UI and AI have been improved.

6.	Spectator Mode
Spectator mode is currently being revamped and will be unavailable until further notice.

7.	Other Changes
1.	Probatio Mark --> Battle Mark
-	The word ‘Probatio’ will be replaced with the word ‘Battle’. It applies to every item, and does not affect its effect.
2.	Quest [Fighting in Style] reward will be adjusted.
'How is my PVP?' [Eltheca] Radiant Magic Stone x15 -> 9 'Costume Modification 1' [Eltheca] Radiant Magic Stone x10 -> 6 'Costume Modification 2' [Eltheca] Radiant Magic Stone x10 -> 6 'Costume Modification 3' [Eltheca] Radiant Magic Stone x10 -> 6  Quest [Mystical Alchemy] will be adjusted to be completed in steps, not at once.

Thank you.

notes.title: December 15th 2021 Weekly Maintenance Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. New Karma (Desperado)
Name: Desperado
Weapon: Rifle
Type: Ranged, Slayer
Desperado is a Ranged Slayer Karma that makes use of the Rifle. Its distinguishing feature is the ability to use command attacks while moving, which allows for many attack options as a ranged Slayer Karma. Skills can be charged in place and/or deal additional damage based on distance from the target. In addition, skills can unlock their true potential when making use of their synergies. With such variety and flexibility in battle styles, Desperado enters the battlefield as a powerful ranged attacker and a new force to be reckoned with. 

2. Added 1 new skill to Crimson Lily
- Skull Smasher: Strike down to cause shockwaves. 
Skull Smasher

3. Karma Balance
[Fallen Light]
Changes to Reload Magic Bullet
 - Changed the number of Magic Bullets reloaded while moving from 2 to 5. 
 - If the player stands still while reloading, what used to be 3 separate stages of motions to reload 2, then 5, then 9 bullets have been changed to a single motion that reloads 9 bullets. 
 - 1 Magic Bullet will be replenished upon evade attack and last hit of aerial attacks.

[Soul of Magus]
Changes to Spirit Rain
 - Reduced the delay between the indication of Spirit Rain to its actual damage from 0.5s to 0.25s. 
 - Changed it to deal damage for all enemies in the area instead of dealing damage based on whether a falling orb hit a target or not. 

[Aegis Knight]
Shield Pull
 - Endurance has been doubled.
Shield Counter
 - Previously, the opponent would be knocked back upon successful counter, but now successful counter will link into Chase command.
 - Counter damage has been increased by 100%.

[Sacred Guardian]
Chain Swing (LMB – LMB – Hold LMB)
- Maximum Duration has been increased from 3.3s to 3.5s.
 - Damage from spinning with the hammer is increased by 300%.
Basic Combo (LMB - LMB - LMB)
 - Transition from 1st hit to 2nd hit is 0.16s faster. 
In addition, the transition from 2nd hit to 3rd hit as well as 2nd hit to Chain Swing (Hold LMB) is 0.1s faster.

4. Item Tooltip Improvements
Each cube item, Soul Stone Extraction Scrolls, and other items with the wrong tooltip descriptions or with inadequate information have been improved. 

5. Reorganized Undergarment Icons
Undergarment icon’s skin color has been changed to all be the same. 

6. Bug Fixes/Improvements
- Fixed the bug where in some situations, Star Player was unobtainable after Deathmatch if the number of expert marks (Kill/Death/Assist/Damage/Max Combo Damage/Break) were the same as another player
- Fixed the bug where the downward smash during an aerial attack with Sacred Guardian would be opposite of the direction that the player is facing
- Fixed the bug where Preview button would persist in the KP Shop if a basic motion was equipped then removed 
- Fixed the bug where the basic settings for filtering in a new player’s collection would be completely removed
- Fixed the bug where certain AI’s faces would not flicker during invulnerability
- Fixed the bug that occurred during Capture the Flag where if a player disconnected while capturing a flag, the gauge to capture that flag would persist

- Skull Smasher: Strike down to cause shockwaves. 
[previewyoutube=_uuXCji5bcs;full][/previewyoutube]

4. Karma Balance

[Fallen Light]
Changes to Reload Magic Bullet
 - Changed the number of Magic Bullets reloaded while moving from 2 to 5. 
 - If the player stands still while reloading, what used to be 3 separate stages of motions to reload 2, then 5, then 9 bullets have been changed to a single motion that reloads 9 bullets. 
 - 1 Magic Bullet will be replenished upon evade attack and last hit of aerial attacks.

[Soul of Magus]
Changes to Spirit Rain
 - Reduced the delay between the indication of Spirit Rain to its actual damage from 0.5s to 0.25s. 
 - Changed it to deal damage for all enemies in the area instead of dealing damage based on whether a falling orb hit a target or not. 

[Aegis Knight]
Shield Pull
  - Endurance has been doubled.
Shield Counter
  - Previously, the opponent would be knocked back upon successful counter, but now successful counter will link into Chase command.
  - Counter damage has been increased by 100%.

Chain Swing (LMB – LMB – Hold LMB)
 - Maximum Duration has been increased from 3.3s to 3.5s.
 - Damage from spinning with the hammer is increased by 300%.

 - Transition from 1st hit to 2nd hit is 0.16s faster. 
In addition, the transition from 2nd hit to 3rd hit as well as 2nd hit to Chain Swing (Hold LMB) is 0.1s faster.

Each cube item, Soul Stone Extraction Scrolls, and other items with the wrong tooltip descriptions or with inadequate information have been improved.

Undergarment icon’s skin color has been changed to all be the same.

notes.title: November 3rd 2021 Weekly Maintenance Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Season 10 (End of Season 9)
Your rating will be soft reset once Season 9 ends and your new rank will be applied with Season 10.
Season 9's rank rewards can be claimed until the end of Season 10.
Make sure to claim your unclaimed rewards before Season 10 ends.

Rank Soft Reset
Your Season 10 Rank will depend on your rank from Season 9.
All ranks will go down by 3.
The highest rank you can get from the reset is B1 and the lowest is D1.
However, all E ranks will be reset to E1.

Ranked Match
Starting from Season 10, Ranked Matches will be played on random matches of Capture the Flag and Deathmatch. 
Your skills in strategizing and tailoring your weapon loadout for the mode, in addition to your abilities in combat will be tested as part of Ranked Matches. 
We will continue to improve the current modes so that players can have diverse, fun experiences. 

Eltheca Theme Change
Eltheca will revert to default theme with the end of the Halloween Season. 

New PVP Map (Temple of Desire)
A new PVP map will be added. Temple of Desire will be added to both Deathmatch and Capture the Flag modes. 
- 2 vs 2 Ranked: Deathmatch, Capture the Flag
- 4 vs 4 Normal: Deathmatch
   
New Variant Color Dyes
New Variant Color Dyes will be added to increase customization options. Rates for dyes will be increased in Supply Boxes. 
We plan on adding a different way to acquire Dyes in addition to drops from Supply Boxes. 
Players will be able to continue to use dyes they have already obtained. 
Variant Color Dye system allows players to adjust saturation for a given color to their liking. 
 

Changes to acquisition of Season Points (Season Quest)
Previously, season points were gained from completing Challenges. Now, season points can be earned as part of the Quest system. 
Earn Season Points from Daily and Weekly Quests. The quests can be completed on either PVE or PVP. 

Expansion to Season Pass Levels 
Starting from the new Season 10 Pass, the maximum level of the Season Pass will be set to Lv.70. The increased level cap also increases the quantity and variety of rewards available through the Season Pass, including Supply Box (Powered Armor), [Eltheca] Magic Stone, and one of 3 emotes (Self Introduction, Fabulous Entrance, Formal Greeting). 

Bug Fixes
- Fixed the bug where after equipping Blazing Fist, previewing a collection costume would make the hands invisible 
- Fixed the bug where character profile would not be displayed in Hall of Fame after changing profile
- Fixed the bug where the key to access Progression System menu does not function in a newly made account after the login cinematic

notes.title: October 20th 2021 Weekly Maintenance Patch Notes
notes.notes:
KurtzPel Systems Revamp

1. Progression System
Progression System will be an account-wide system that allows players to earn rewards as they gain levels from in-game activities for the account. Progression Levels are gained by leveling up Karma and reflects a total of the player’s Karma Levels.
Previously, each character had their own Karma Level but after the system update, all characters on the same account will share the same Karma Level. For example, if a player made a new character, that player used to start from scratch to level up Karmas. After this update, players will be able to start with whatever pre-existing Karma levels player have obtained from their previous characters on the same account. Pre-existing Karmas Levels on multiple characters from before the system update will be combined into one total Karma Level per Karma that can be shared across all characters account-wide. 
Karma Level cap will be removed to allow repetitive leveling and rewards through the Progression System.
Leveling up Progression will reward a box, which has a set chance to drop ‘GP, Armor Costume, Accessory Costume, Magic Stone, Resurrection Stone, Potion, or Special Enhancement Stone’.

2. Tutorial Mode
Tutorial Mode will give new and returning KurtzPel players unfamiliar with the game a chance to learn and practice the battle systems before jumping into matches against other players.  
This will provide a much-needed tutorial for the game as well as an opportunity for players to choose and practice specific aspects of combat.

3. Road to Grand Chase 
Road to Grand Chase is a 1v1 Deathmatch mode where players will be able to face AI of varying difficulties as their opponent. The opponent and the map will be randomized. Players can tackle the next difficulty after they have cleared the previous one. 
Players will be able to challenge themselves against AI ranging from Rank E to Rank A to develop their skills. 

4. PVE Revamp 
Character levels will be removed for PVE. Equipment acquired before the PVE revamp along with their stats, enhancements, and sockets will remain the same. 
Although character levels will be removed, players will be able to continue leveling up their Karmas through PVE and receive Progression rewards.


5. Collection System
The all-new collection system will be added. This system will allow players to check costumes & accessories that currently exist in KurtzPel. The collection system will reward players with new collection items including Title, Profile, and a new accessory slot.
If the player completes a fixed collection based on the costume outfits and accessories the player currently possesses, the player will able to receive the new rewards. We will add more collection materials in following updates. 
Rewards obtainable from Collection 

6. Changes to Karma acquisition
To ‘normal unlock’ a Karma, what previously required CP will now require a certain amount of gameplay to unlock.
Special unlock will work the same as before through ‘Heroic Karma Token’.
When a Karma is unlocked, players will start from Karma Level 0. Unlocking a Karma will also give the player access to all skills (active and passive) from the start. 
Karmas acquired from before the update will also continue to be available.

7. Removal of Karma Level-dependent Skill Tree
The skill tree system will be removed to eliminate the impact it may give to match results based on whether someone had certain skills or not. All players will have access to the same active and passive skills acquired from unlocking their respective Karmas. Any skills that gave bonus stats will be removed completely.

8. Removal of the Awakening System
Awakening Skills served to bring a lot of changes to gameplay, but acquiring it required a lot of play time. Also, balancing around the fact that players may or may not have awakening skills proved to be very problematic. Therefore, the Awakening system will be removed.
Normal awakening skills will be provided upon unlocking the Karma. 
Awakening bonuses such as Increase Karma Slot, Increase Stats, and Rage Awakening skills will be removed from the game. 

9. Quest System Revamp 
Daily and Weekly Challenges from before will be merged into the Quest System. 
Following this merge, Quest Log will have a ‘Daily’ category in which players can do quests and receive rewards on a daily basis. 
Any unfinished quests when the system update arrives will be deleted. Please complete any ongoing quests before the system update arrives. 
Quests used to be on a per character basis but after the system update, quests will be account-wide. Make sure to complete quests on the desired character as the quest and rewards will not be given to other characters on the account once the quest has been completed on a certain character. 

10. Randomized Magic Stone Stat Revamp  
Previously existing magic stone stat system will be changed for Karma, Costume Weapon, Costume Outfit, and Costume Accessories. 
Magic Stone stats will be removed from Karmas. 

11. Currency System Changes
Due to changes to Karma progression, DP will be removed. 
CP will also be removed. CP will be converted to the new currency GP. 
Everything that used to cost CP will now cost GP instead. 

12. End of ongoing Attendance Event
The current Attendance Event in progress will be deleted due to changes and removal of items rewarded in the event. 
Please make sure to claim any unclaimed items in the current Attendance Event. Once the update is implemented, you will no longer be able to claim any unclaimed attendance rewards. 

13. New Theme for Eltheca 
Eltheca will have a new Halloween theme. 
In-game cinematic upon login will be added to help increase immersion. 

14. Karma Balance
[Universal] 
- Reduced Karma’s Base Crit Rate 
Breaker: 25% -> 5%
Slayer: 30% -> 10%

[Dance of Wind]
- Added a delay before the skill is activated for Raining Arrows (0.25s)
- Changed the first attack after evasion (Does not launch, 20% reduced damage, 50% reduced break damage)

notes.title: End of Sale for KP Shop Items affected by System Revamp Update
notes.notes:
Hello Chasers,

We are currently preparing for a system revamp to make changes to KurtzPel’s game systems not directly related to gameplay starting mid-October. 

With this revamp, KurtzPel will undergo changes and improvements to systems, which we received much feedback about, including the randomized magic stone system, awakening, as well as overall game progression. 

As a result, certain items will be changed or removed. The items listed below will no longer be available for sale at the KP Shop after the maintenance on 2021-09-29. Those who have purchased/used items listed below will be compensated with KP and/or items.  

(Compensations will be issued with the system revamp update. The exact date of compensation as well as the details of the upcoming changes will be announced at a later date.)

End of Sale Items
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ed78cc5b1166fbabd35af7bd730197ffb4f82d56.png

1. AP+100% Booster (1 Day)
- Reason for End of Sale: Pre-existing Karma level will be maintained but Karma levels will be expanded, and as a result of changes to related systems, AP’s usage will change. Sale of this item will end to control value and effectiveness of AP. 
- Compensation for used items: None because previously earned Karma levels will be maintained
- Compensation for unused items: 1x AP+50% Booster (1 Day) per unused AP Booster 
- Note: Same Booster compensation regardless of whether you have [[Eltheca]AP+100% Booster] or [AP+100% Booster] 

2. CP+100% Booster (1 Day)
- Reason for End of Sale: CP will be removed. New currency called GP will replace it. 
- Compensation for used items: Allow conversion of CP to GP
- Compensation for unused items: 1x GP+50% Booster (1 Day) per unused CP Booster
- Note: Same Booster compensation regardless of whether you have [[Eltheca]CP+100% Booster] or [CP+100% Booster] 

3. EXP+100% Booster (1 Day)
- Reason for End of Sale: the concept of EXP will no longer be relevant as character levels will be removed as part of the PVE changes.
- Compensation for used items: Compensation based on the amount of EXP earned (Will be announced at a later date)
- Compensation for unused items: 1x [+50% Booster (1 Day) Select Cube] per unused EXP Booster
- Note: Same Booster compensation regardless of whether you have [[Eltheca]EXP+100% Booster] or [EXP+100% Booster] / [+50% Booster (1 Day) Select Cube] Contents: Choose 1 of [AP+50% Booster (1 Day)] or [GP+50% Booster (1 Day)]

4. 7 Days, 30 Days Boosters
- Compensation for unused items: AP and GP Boosters corresponding to number of days on unused boosters
- Compensation for remaining period on already used items: If there is a remaining period on a booster already used and in effect, then based on the booster used, 7 Days or 30 Days Booster will be issued.
 
5. Boosters (Hours)
- Compensation for used items: None
- Compensation for unused items in Inventory, Trading Post, or Mailbox: AP +50% Booster (1 Day) or GP +50% Booster (1 Day) for each applicable Booster. 

6. Booster Package (1 Day)
- Reason for End of Sale: Package will no longer be sold due to changes in contents of the package.
- Compensation for used items: Follows compensations listed above for each component booster
- Compensation for unused items: Since unused packages can only be located in KP Shop Inventory, each unused package in KP Shop Inventory will be replaced with 3x [+50% Booster (1 Day) Select Cube]
- Note: [+50% Booster (1 Day) Select Cube] Contents: Choose 1 of [AP+50% Booster (1 Day)] or [GP+50% Booster (1 Day)]

7. DP Coin (300)
- Reason for End of Sale: DP Points will be removed due to changes, so the related item will be removed from the shop. 
- Compensation for used items: [500 Bonus KP] equal to number of DP Coin (300) used 
- Compensation for unused items: [500 Bonus KP] per unused DP Coin (300)
- Note: Compensation excludes DP Coins bought from the KP Shop then traded for CP at the Trading Post

8. Radiant Magic Stone (Karma, Weapon, Outfit, Accessory)
- Reason for End of Sale: Magic Stones will now allow selection of a stat instead of rolling a random stat.
- Compensation for used items: [Radiant Magic Stone] equal to the number of Radiant Magic Stones purchased and used from the KP Shop
- Compensation for unused items: [Radiant Magic Stone] per unused Radiant Magic Stone
- Note: 

 [Radiant Magic Stone] will be given as compensation regardless of whether you had or used [Eltheca] Radiant Magic Stone or Radiant Magic Stone
 [Radiant Magic Stone] is a material item that allows the player to choose the stat option they want on their costume
 For normal magic stones, we plan on providing a way to synthesize them into [Radiant Magic Stone]

9. Awakening Tome
- Reason for End of Sale: Awakening system will be removed as part of the upcoming changes. Related skills will be reassigned to not require awakening to obtain. 
- Compensation for used items: 
Awakening Tome = 1,000 KP
[Eltheca] Awakening Tome = [Supply Box Select Cube] x3 + [+50% Booster (1 Day) Select Cube] x1
- Compensation for unused items: 
For each Awakening Tome = 1,000 KP
[Eltheca] Awakening Tome = [Supply Box Select Cube] x3 + [+50% Booster (1 Day) Select Cube] x1
- Note: 

 [Supply Box Select Cube] Contents: Choose 1 of [Supply Box (Dark Knight)], [Supply Box (Nightmare)], or [Supply Box (Seraphim)]

notes.title: August 19th 2021 Weekly Maintenance Patch Notes
notes.notes:
New Karma - Crimson Lily
Name: Crimson LIly
Weapon: Double Glaive
Type: Melee, Breaker
Crimson Lily is a Breaker that uses Double Glaive as its weapon. 
Crimson Lily can sustain its attacks by freely changing forms of Double Glaive. Its skills consume HP in return for higher attack and even lifesteal depending on the situation. How long you sustain yourself off this lifesteal is entirely up to you and how you handle it. With high damage and sustain from lifesteal, Crimson Lily poses a new threat on the battlefield.  

Improvement to maximum party size
Following the 4vs4 Normal Match update, we changed maximum party size to 4 players. 

Bug Fix
1) Fixed the bug where if karma was switched quickly while dashing, dash would activate again after the switch 
2) Fixed the bug where Sacred Guardian would occasionally drop straight to the ground when using Crusade in the air. 
3) Fixed the bug where the debuff duration increase passive did not apply to stun from Sacred Guardian’s ‘Crusade’ 
4) Fixed the bug where after dying from Dual Soul’s ‘Rend’, debuff icon would remain after reviving
5) Fixed the bug where if Lightning Fang’s ‘Tomb of Blades’ is used, the effects of it would also be shown to other characters.  
6) Fixed the bug where Lightning Fang would sometimes not be able to combo after chase depending on what action speed the Lightning Fang user has. 
7) Fixed issues with PVP skill balance adjustments affecting PVE
[Sword Taliah]
Spinning Rising Slash: Damage and break damage reduced 30% (PVP)
[Blazing Fist]
Blazing Strike: Damage reduced 30% (PVP)
[Sacred Guardian]
Judgment: Damage reduced 30% (PVP)
[Ruler of Darkness]
Death Blossom: Damage reduced 30% (PVP)

notes.notes:
PVP Season 9
Pre-season has ended and Season 9 will begin. Your Season 9 Rank will depend on your rank from Season 8. All ranks will go down by 3. The highest rank you can get from the reset is B1 and the lowest is D1. However, all E ranks will be reset to E1

Season Pass and Season Points and their associated rewards you acquired during the Pre-season will be maintained into the regular season. You can use them until end of Season 9.

Karma Balance
[Sword Taliah]
• Spinning Rising Slash: Reduced damage and break damage (PVP)
[Diabolic Witch]
• Mana Ray: Fixed to not let it penetrate through terrain
[Blazing Fist]

• Reduced break damage of first LMB attack from charging RMB
- Fixed break damage to properly scale based on how long RMB was charged
• Ultimate Heat: Fixed to register the attack even if you are in the same position as the enemy.
[Sacred Guardian]
• Judgment: Reduced damage (PVP)
[Ruler of Darkness]

Season 9 Event

• Fixed the bug where weapon size would scale based on character’s Body Fat and/or Body Style during character customization.

notes.title: July 21st 2021 Weekly Maintenance Patch Notes
notes.notes:
New Awakening
1.	Lightning Fang Awakening

Improvements
1 Mission Card Improvements
- We have removed 5 vs 5 Destruction. 
- Instead, we have added it to 4 vs 4 Normal Match. One of Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Conquest, or Destruction modes will be randomly chosen for normal matchmaking. All Normal Matches will have no effect on rankings or ratings regardless of match results. 
- 4 vs 4 Capture the Flag rules have changed. Because this mode was previously meant for 3 vs 3, with the change in number of players, we decided to increase the number of flags that spawn from 1 to 2 at a time and increased points needed to win to 1000 as well. 

2.Mana Restored 
After testing and community feedback from Beta Mode and Pre-season, we have decided to revert the mana removal changes. For the players who changed their option stats from 7/7 to 7/21 will once again be allowed change stat options by using ‘Selective Magic Stones’ that will be provided after this maintenance on July 21st. Please remember to use this item before it expires on UTC+0 2021-08-04 05:00. Because mana will be re-added to the game, the event that allowed you to change away from mana related option stat will end earlier than initially planned with the 7/21 update.

3.Attacks will now use Stamina 
To limit the potential of infinite combos, we decided to make attacks consume stamina. 
Previously, in return for reducing the difficulty of resource management and combo execution, we implemented a ‘Combo Limit System’ to try and control combo duration. From what we have learned over the past several seasons, we determined that the Combo Limit System was awkward and reduced opportunities for skillful combo executions. We plan on emphasizing skillful combo executions that takes controls and resource management into account as we go forward. 

4.Karma Balance Changes
[All Karmas]
- Reduced break damage on certain Rage Skills (cannot interrupt skills any more) 
* We reduced break damage because it was not our intention to have this be used as a way to counter enemies who get close. 
* This change only applies to certain Slayer Rage Skills that applies buffs and have no immediate direct damage component. The intended targets for this change include Great Archer’s Soul and Demonic Awakening.
- Attacks now consume Stamina
 * We plan on applying combo mechanics that must utilize both command attacks that use stamina and skill attacks that recover stamina in order to make use of its full potential.
We made this change to reduce infinite combos that were possible from repeating basic command attacks, which reduced the need to learn any combos, and to address the frustration that anyone feels, regardless of gameplay experience, when they are on the receiving end of a seemingly endless combo.  
- Reduced Stamina needed to use Dash (33%)
 * Stamina consumption was increased unintentionally, so we decided to reduce the stamina needed to dash. 
- All Karma Movement Speeds increased
　	Melee Breaker	Melee Slayer	Ranged Slayer 
Movement Speed Increase %	4.5%	4.3%	5.0%

[Sword Taliah]
- Removed Fortitude’s effect that increases endurance and replaced it with effect that increases defense (50%)

[Dance of Wind]
- Reduced endurance damage by Raining Arrows (25%)
- Reduced charged LMB range (16%)
- Removed break damage increase from Great Archer’s Soul 

[Fallen Light]
- Reduced radius of Lightning Trap (25%)

[Lightning Fang]
- Changed to make blink effect more obvious
- Reduced knockback distance from last hit of air attack sequence 
- Right click after landing from aerial attacks will consume more stamina 

[Diabolic Witch]
- You cannot move until Circle of Elements completes activation 
- Reduced initial endurance damage of Circle of Elements 
- Reduced flinching after activating Demon Awakening (0.6 second)

[Aegis Knight]
- Reduced knockback distance from aerial right click to allow combos to continue (Stamina consumption increased)
- Changed it so that enemy doesn’t fall too fast after doing aerial LMB attacks (after 3 LMBs in a row while in the air, it should be easier to continue a combo) 

[Sacred Guardian]
- Reduced knockback from last attack of aerial attacks so that combos can continue. (Stamina consumption increased)

[Soul of Magus]
- Increased action speed for LMB-LMB-LMB-RMB attack.

5.Bug fixes 
1) Fixed the bug where if you slammed down while holding on to a monster with Blazing Fist, the HP bar would change locations.
2) Fixed the bug where it was possible to grab an enemy while they were knocked down (i.e., Blazing Fist – Grab, Reckless Charge/ Lightning Fang - Lightning Drop, etc.)
3) Fixed the bug where some items from the Supply Box (Seraphim) would not be listed on the Trading Post (i.e., Lire’s Eryuell Archer Dress, Kien's Trinity Outfit Top Piece, etc.) 
4) Fixed the bug where Skill Cooldown option stat affected Evasion cooldown.

notes.title: July 7th 2021 Weekly Maintenance Patch Notes
notes.notes:
PVP Season 9 Pre-season
As PVP Season 8 comes to an end, before Season 9 begins, Season 9 Pre-season will begin. 
This pre-season will give us an opportunity to reevaluate the changes tested through the Beta Mode one last time and serve as a transition period as rankings and other matters are sorted for Destruction to become a proper Ranked Match mode.
Your Pre-season and Season 9 rank will depend on your rank from Season 8.
Destruction will have no effect on your Pre-season 9 rankings. 
All ranks will go down by 3.
The highest rank you can get after reset is B1 and the lowest is D1.
However, all E ranks will be reset to E1. 

PVP Season 9 Pre-season Mission Card
For Season 9, starting from the Pre-season, we are planning on improving matchmaking and modes that see less play. 
From the Mission list, the following modes will be removed:
  - Capture the Flag
  - Conquest
  - 3vs3 Deathmatch
  - Survival (Beta Mode)
Normal Match Destruction as well as Ranked Match 2v2 Deathmatch and AI Deathmatch will remain. 

PVP Season 9 Pre-season Changes
  - Improvements to Battle UI
  - Removed mana resource from PVP
Because mana is getting removed from PVP, we will hold an event that gives an opportunity for you to replace purple and golden magic stones with “Max Mana” or “Mana Recovery (Sec.)” options to another option. 
  - Removed Natural Recovery
  - Removed Blow System
  - Removed Invincibility during knockdown
  - Removed combo limit system
  - Added Invincibility during Breakfall
  - Movement speed adjusted for all Karmas
  - Changed Fallen Light’s dash attack and chase attack
  - QoL improvements for Sword Taliah, Dance of Wind, and Diabolic Witch RMB expansion attack

Destruction Mode Balance Changes
  - Removed HP Recovery from set of buffs received from defeating Chaos. (Recharge Rage Gauge /Increase Attack +100%/Increase Action Speed +10%/Increase Movement Speed +30%)
  - Teammates who didn’t participate in defeating the Golem or Chaos will no longer receive experience from the defeated Golem or Chaos.
  - Reduced experience needed to level up after Lv. 11 to accelerate leveling. 

Karma Balance Changes
[Fallen Light]
  - Reduced Rapid Shot range by 50%
  - Reduced damage of Lightning Shot in PVP by 50% and removed endurance damage in PVP

[Blazing Fist]
  - Reduced range of Instant Chase (29%)
  - Reduced max duration of Falling Star in the air (40%)
  - Reduced endurance damage from Blazing Strike hits (45%); Cannot interrupt Storm Slash

[Dance of Wind]
  - RMB Expansion > if you keep holding RMB, it will automatically convert to RMB Charge attack (You can still double tap directional buttons as before) 
  - Skills that used to require Aiming can now be used when skill key is pressed even without Aiming first (Affects: Spirit Arrow, Salvo Arrow)
  - Non-Aiming skills can now be used while aiming

[Diabolic Witch]
  - RMB Hold on Ground to regen mana is removed
  - RMB Expansion > When you hold RMB, it will now automatically change attack attributes
  - RMB Expansion > Dashing can be done while holding RMB
  - Releasing RMB will launch attacks
  - Circle of Elements: Reduced PVP damage (30%), reduced knock up height of damaged enemy and added knockback 

[Soul of Magus]
  - Reduced PVP damage of Spirit Rain (30%)
  - Reduced PVP damage of Lingering Souls (20%) and removed endurance damage

[Dual Soul]
  - Reduced bleed damage from Beast Fang by 50% 

Season Pass – Season 9
Season Pass – Season 9 will begin after July 7th, 2021 (Wed) maintenance, starting from the pre-season period. You can complete and be rewarded for Season Pass challenges during the pre-season. Once Season 9 starts, your Season Pass progress will carry over. 

On/Off feature for Costumes while customizing
While customizing during character creation, changing appearance, or rebirth, you can toggle on/off costume you currently have equipped. 

Bug fix
  - Fixed the bug where after changing gender from rebirth, you could preview emotes of the opposite gender from the list of emotes you currently have. 
  - Fixed the bug where your character would flicker after clearing a floor of the Abyss. 
  - Fixed the bug where Rage gauge looked like it was partially charged under special circumstances
  - Fixed the bug where passive skills that should increase buff/debuff duration for normal skills only unintentionally affected rage skill 
  - Fixed the bug where HP bar for the target grabbed by Blazing Fist would be displayed abnormally
  - Fixed the bug where using Whirlwind with Blazing Fist would allow its user to grab an opponent outside of its intended range.

Destruction (Beta Mode) Changes

- Limited Matchmaking Periods (18:00 – 23:00 (5 hours) for each Server’s Time Zone)
- Increased Rewards
- Changed character nickname text color for neutral monster kill notification 

Reduced Soul Scythe size while equipped
We reduced the size of Soul Scythe to make it easier to view it in various UIs. In both PVE and PVP, size and attack range remain unchanged while using the weapon. The size is only changed for when you have it equipped and resting on your back. 

Improved Training Grounds Command and Skill Guide
We changed formal expressions of some commands and skills in Training Grounds.
Changes are centered around what ‘Launch’ and ‘Knocked Down’ means.
Previously, we used ‘Launch’ to note the situations where an enemy would be knocked up high into the air.  From now on, regardless of the height to which enemies are sent, if the end result knocks enemy down on the ground, then that will be referred to as ‘Knocked Down’.
We will only use ‘Launch’ when the enemy is flung into the air without being knocked down.

AI Change
In AI PVP, we determined that ‘Sacred Guardian’ AI is more aggressive and has bigger influence on outcome of the match than other AIs and as a result, we decided to remove it. 
We also added the new ‘Dual Soul’ AI. 
We also made improvements to all remaining AI to move more naturally overall.  

Bug Fixes

- Fixed the bug with special key input not registering if Karma switch key was changed from the default Tab.

- Fixed the bug with the wrong roll cooldown showing on UI when switching to a karma with a different roll cooldown. 
- Fixed the bug where you move too far when doing LMB + Evade with Kunai

Beta Mode
1. 2 vs 2 Deathmatch (Beta Mode)
The Deathmatch (Beta Mode) will come to an end. We would like to thank every single one of you for testing and providing your feedback via the survey. We do our best to take your feedback and continue to improve KurtzPel.

2. Destruction – Beta Mode
Press (M) then select ‘Destruction’ on the ‘Battle’ tab to play the new 5v5 PVP mode. 
To play Destruction, you must have 5 or more Karmas and you must choose 1 Karma that you want to play with for the entire match.  
It is not an official mode yet so this mode can be enjoyed without worrying about win/loss records affecting your ranking. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/1b25b7f680317223a5a6e9114e999c4a707ec955.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/3bb6eb24d06d0183e190a2cbb8c728ea2c089e0e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ac6686eed04ea844822833b061437c93d87cdf23.png

Game Rules 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/91325e96265eeda8a8b8a5ad80b0c695e218d3a0.png
- Players: 5 vs 5
- Win Condition: Destroy the last tower in the enemy base
- Play Time Limit: None
- Special Rules
1) You must choose 1 Karma to play (You cannot switch Karmas while playing Destruction.) / Allies cannot use the same Karma
2) Equipment, Costume, Set Items, Karma Passives, and all other stat effects do not apply. All players will start the game with the same stats. 
3) All characters will have the same set of motions and will not be adjusted to individual character features. 
4) Combo limit has been removed for Destruction mode.

How to Play
1) Defeat enemy characters, monsters, and neutral monsters to increase your level.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/514f9961fa409e90b60b9bac93c484bf6836a40f.jpg
2) When you level up, your stats will increase and you will unlock a skill or increase a level on a skill. 
(When you level up, select the desired skill to level it up (default: number keys 1-4)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/9b9e2cdec85c15282fe8f050febeaff0f92380c6.jpg
3)Defeat neutral monsters to gain buffs or summon monsters to your side. 
- Golem: Defeat the Golem to have it become your ally for a set duration. Fight with it to destroy the enemy towers. 
(A much stronger Golem will spawn after it is defeated for the 3rd time.)
- Chaos: Defeat the Chaos to grant your allies with powerful Hero Buffs for a set duration.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/71fa6379f9adba349eacc6b0c9f301602dcf5f7c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a155b554862095ffa65dc2a11a3822650312c4b0.jpg
4)Make use of your character progression and neutral monsters to destroy enemy towers all the way to their final base tower to win.

Tip
1) Press the (G) key on your keyboard to see information about the current match. 
2) Press the (B) key on your keyboard to recall to your base.
3) Go to designated region in your base to recover your HP. 
4) Neutral monsters will start recovering HP if they leave their territory. 
5) When you die, you will be respawned at the start point. Your respawn timer will increase with your levels. 

Reward
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/815c1ff0eec52e72c69a426137df1e02a3805bb7.jpg

Karma Balance Changes (Limited to Destruction)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/5d71171dcace23c88181b75dccf16938dd71445c.jpg

Control Revamp (Limited to Destruction – Beta Mode)
You can experience the control revamp in ‘Destruction’ – Beta Mode. 
We limited the changes to Destruction so that you can play and test these changes for yourself before they are applied to the rest of the game. 

1) Mana still Removed but Stamina is Restored
Mana will continue to be removed and skills will solely depend on cooldowns.
Stamina has been restored and Dash Spheres are removed. 

2) Changes due to Stamina being Restored
Because stamina is restored the below will be changed. 
- Dual Soul’s RMB command will consume stamina
- Blazing Fist’s Dash RMB will consume stamina
- Soul of Magus’ Aerial RMB will consume stamina
- Lightning Fang’s RMB will consume stamina. 
- Ruler of Darkness’ Aerial Flight will consume stamina

3) Blow System removed
We decided to remove the Blow System because it was hard to recognize and also, it was frustrating to be stuck in a combo for so long. 

4) Combining Dash & Evade has been Removed
We heard your feedback loud and clear and we decided to remove the decision to combine dash & evade as many of you pointed out that it actually took away the uniqueness and combo mechanics of individual Karmas. The dash & evade system has been restored to its original system.

5) Natural Recovery removed
This was removed due to giving winning players an advantage by encouraging them to run away with the lead and making the games boring as a result.
Also with this change, we removed restriction on healing skills healing only to specific amounts, so healing skills can now be 100% effective at all times.

6) Movement Speed Adjustment
We received many feedbacks that the current movement speed was too slow so we've made it a bit faster than before.
To account for kiting by ranged Karmas against melee Karmas, we gave melee Karmas 15% faster movement speed.

7) Knockdown, Breakfall Changes
- Knockdown State
Removed invincibility from Knockdown state. You can now take damage from attacks during Knockdown. 
- Breakfall
Breakfall is used to get out of Knockdown quickly but follow-up attacks from enemies made this maneuver less effective than intended. Therefore, we added invincibility during Breakfall so that you can stand up from knockdown without taking damage!

8) Difficult Control Improvements
We made the following changes to address difficulties in Dash during Charging, using skills while Aiming, and recovering Special Resources.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a0b0ef3465ba987297477747f56f7ef7f23172e8.jpg

Destruction (Beta Mode) Improvements
1) Ping System
While playing Destruction (Beta Mode), you will be able to communicate and strategize with your teammate with ease with the new Ping system.
- While playing, hold down the ALT key to switch to 'Ping Mode' which will make your mouse cursor appear on top of the minimap.
- When you are in Ping Mode (hold ALT), you can still use your other keys and Ping Mode can be activated while you are incapacitated as well.
- You can ping your teammates on the minimap with LMB and RMB.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a47d643203b8b407f591537d49290dc4fa1253a3.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ff19be0059b7f68e52d86444dbaca1bf930f60b6.png

2) Spectator System
When you are incapacitated by the enemy, you will be able spectate your living teammates with the new Spectator System.
While you are incapacitated, press the A & D key on your keyboard to spectate your living teammates.
- A Key: Previous Teammate
- D Key: Next Teammate
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/4b2eba8c9d0d2651a23f792a73f7f06906dc8aa8.png

New Awakening
• Aegis Knight Awakening
- Awakening is coming for Aegis Knight!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/87baff7835342abf93631c650d2a7a616eb0da0f.png

- How to unlock Awakening
Reach Lv.20 and Karma Lv.6 on your character, then you will be able to talk to the NPC inside Eltheca to receive the Awakening Quest. Once complete, you will receive an item that will unlock your awakening. These awakening quests can be complete by playing dungeons within your level range or can be unlocked by purchasing Awakening Tomes in the KP Shop.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/581cfdfd5422508777767704dd8793acae5ce371.png

- Karma Skill Tree Expansion
When you unlock your awakening, you can level up your karma up to Lv.11 and you can become stronger with each level by acquiring passives or new skills.

Expanded Aegis Knight Skill Tree
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/e9375932c9987531a67a6713648cd7fa54d17691.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/96cdfe5b19ff2d49d2f9217451c5dcb68ec224fa.jpg

Aegis Knight New Awakening Skill – Thunderous Charge
Charge forward and crash into an enemy with great force. If your charge is successful, the target hit will become airborne.
[previewyoutube=YFNF-HI3QCo;full][/previewyoutube]
Aegis Knight New Awakening Rage Skill – Grand Cross EX
Trap enemies in front of you then slash them in large, sweeping motion.
[previewyoutube=tD5hF3VEiwM;full][/previewyoutube]
With this update, all Karma's max level will be increased from 5 to 6 but only Sword Taliah, Dance of Wind, Diabolic Witch, Blazing Fist, Dual Soul, Sacred Guardian, Fallen Light, Ruler of Darkness, Soul of Magus, and Aegis Knight will be able to reach Lv.11 through Awakening.

- Awakening Gauge
Once you unlock your Awakening, you will be able to use the Awakening Gauge in dungeons.
Your awakening gauge will increase by dealing damage to monsters and the amount of gauge increased will depend on your damage. Once you have filled up your awakening gauge, you will be able to activate it with L-Alt key. When the Awakening Gauge is active, your movement speed, attack power, stamina recovery, and mana recovery will be increased for a set duration.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b41e61d4d15ef945c6499ba599587de803c7b0ca.jpg
When your Awakening is active, you can perfectly dodge an enemy's attack to slow everything around you and gain additional movement speed, action speed, mana/stamina/hp recovery increase buff.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/0ea7c511140451504e0a37a89c6f679d70435698.jpg
When you acquire the Awakening Rage Skill by hitting Lv.10 on your Karma, you will be able to use the Awakening Rage Skill by awakening with a full rage bar. The awakening rage skill must be used before the Awakening effect expires.

- Effect of Awakening Skills on PVP & PVE
Certain awakening system and skills will only be usable in dungeons. We are still reviewing the possibility of allowing awakening skills in PVP but only after awakening for all karmas are released.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/1d944aff3a28c39d2ee9773d6ed6d493b343c18f.jpg

We limited the changes to Deathmatch (Beta Mode) so that you can play and test these changes for yourself before they are applied to the rest of the game. 

1) Mana still Removed but Stamina is Restored
Mana will continue to be removed and skills will solely depend on cooldowns.
Stamina has been restored and Dash Spheres are removed. 

2) Changes due to Stamina being Restored
Because stamina is restored the below will be changed. 
- Dual Soul’s RMB command will consume stamina
- Blazing Fist’s Dash RMB will consume stamina
- Soul of Magus’ Aerial RMB will consume stamina
- Lightning Fang’s RMB will consume stamina.
- Ruler of Darkness’ Aerial Flight will consume stamina

3) Blow System removed
We decided to remove the Blow System because it was hard to recognize and also, it was frustrating to be stuck in a combo for so long. 

4) Combining Dash & Evade has been Removed
We heard your feedback loud and clear and we decided to remove the decision to combine dash & evade as many of you pointed out that it actually took away the uniqueness and combo mechanics of individual Karmas. The dash & evade system has been restored to its original system.

5) Natural Recovery removed
This was removed due to giving winning players an advantage by encouraging them to run away with the lead and making the games boring as a result.
Also with this change, we removed restriction on healing skills healing only to specific amounts, so healing skills can now be 100% effective at all times.

6) Movement Speed Adjustment
We received many feedbacks that the current movement speed was too slow so we've made it a bit faster than before.
To account for kiting by ranged Karmas against melee Karmas, we gave melee Karmas 10% faster movement speed.

7) Knockdown, Breakfall Changes
- Knockdown State
Removed invincibility from Knockdown state. You can now take damage from attacks during Knockdown. 
- Breakfall
Breakfall is used to get out of Knockdown quickly but follow-up attacks from enemies made this maneuver less effective than intended. Therefore, we added invincibility during Breakfall so that you can stand up from knockdown without taking damage!

8) Difficult Control Improvements
We made the following changes to address difficulties in Dash during Charging, using skills while Aiming, and recovering Special Resources.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/9b9e2cdec85c15282fe8f050febeaff0f92380c6.jpg

3)	If you defeat a neutral monster, you can gain buffs or summon monsters on your side. 
- Golem: Defeat the Golem to have it become your ally for a set duration and fight on your side to destroy enemy towers.
- Chaos: Defeat the Chaos to grant your allies with powerful Hero Buffs for a set duration. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a155b554862095ffa65dc2a11a3822650312c4b0.jpg

4)	Progress your character and use the neutral monsters to destroy enemy towers all the way to their final base tower to win

This mode’s rules will apply alongside some control changes as we mentioned earlier. 
Check out the details below!

[Control Change Details] 

1.	Stamina/Mana removed
We simplified resource management so that you can better focus on the battle itself. 

2.	Changes due to Stamina removal
Because stamina is removed, some command skills had to be adjusted.  
- Dual Soul’s RMB movement distance reduced. 
- Blazing Fist’s Dash RMB will now use Dash Spheres.  
- Soul of Magus’ Aerial RMB will now use Dash Spheres. 
- Lightning Fang’s RMB reflect will now use Dash Spheres when reflect is successful. 
- Ruler of Darkness’ Aerial Flight will now use Dash Spheres. 

3.	Blow System removed
We decided to remove the Blow System because it was hard to recognize and also, it was frustrating to be stuck in a combo for so long. 


4.	Combining Dash & Evade
We combined Dash & Evade because they serve a similar purpose and to make it easier to manage. The new dash moves a greater distance than when these skills were used consecutively. Just spamming this skill can now put you at a disadvantage and allow enemies to punish you.
However, to minimize drastic changes from pre-existing play patterns, both the dash key and the evade key can be used to activate the new Dash. 
-	Max 3 Dash Spheres (New resource consumed from activating Dash)
-	At the start of the game, all players start with 3 Dash Spheres. 
-	Invincibility during Dash (Evade)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ed454e76daa8df0bbf5eac747fad73da59c8c2d3.png

5.	Natural Recovery removed
This was removed due to giving winning players an advantage by encouraging them to run away with the lead and making the games boring as a result. 
Also with this change, we removed restriction on healing skills healing only to specific amounts, so healing skills can now be 100% effective at all times. 

6.	Movement Speed reduced
To control the speed of the game overall, we reduced basic movement speed and movement speed increase from Dash Sprint. 
To account for kiting by ranged Karmas against melee Karmas, we gave melee Karmas 10% faster movement speed. 


7.	Knockdown, Breakfall changes
-	Knockdown State
Removed invincibility from Knockdown state. You can now take damage from attacks during Knockdown. 

-	Breakfall 
Breakfall is used to get out of Knockdown quickly but follow-up attacks from enemies made this maneuver less effective than intended. Therefore, we added invincibility during Breakfall so that you can stand up from knockdown without taking damage! 

8.	Difficult Control Improvements
We made the following changes to address difficulties in Dash during Charging, using skills while Aiming, and recovering Special Resources. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/5402833cb4fbf3feb3a6a6eeec55a09ecc750d5d.png

-	How to unlock Awakening
Reach Lv.20 and Karma Lv.6 on your character, then you will be able to talk to the NPC inside Eltheca to receive the Awakening Quest. Once complete, you will receive an item that will unlock your awakening. These awakening quests can be complete by playing dungeons within your level range or can be unlocked by purchasing Awakening Tomes in the KP Shop.

[previewyoutube=2m9xIB9rOs8;full][/previewyoutube]

The Reaper creates a zone of darkness that attacks multiple times.
[previewyoutube=8UGjqQt9TEU;full][/previewyoutube]

With this update, all Karma's max level will be increased from 5 to 6 but only Sword Taliah, Dance of Wind, Diabolic Witch, Blazing Fist, Dual Soul, Sacred Guardian, Fallen Light, and Ruler of Darkness will be able to reach Lv.11 through Awakening.

-	Awakening Gauge
Once you unlock your Awakening, you will be able to use the Awakening Gauge in dungeons.
Your awakening gauge will increase by dealing damage to monsters and the amount of gauge increased will depend on your damage. Once you have filled up your awakening gauge, you will be able to activate it with L-Alt key. When the Awakening Gauge is active, your movement speed, attack power, stamina recovery, and mana recovery will be increased for a set duration.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b41e61d4d15ef945c6499ba599587de803c7b0ca.jpg

When your Awakening is active, you can perfectly dodge an enemy's attack to slow everything around you and gain additional movement speed, action speed, mana/stamina/hp recovery increase buff.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/0ea7c511140451504e0a37a89c6f679d70435698.jpg

When you acquire the Awakening Rage Skill by hitting Lv.10 on your Karma, you will be able to use the Awakening Rage Skill by awakening with a full rage bar. The awakening rage skill must be used before the Awakening effect expires.

-	Awakening Activation
You will no longer be able to activate awakening while using rage skills

-	Effect of Awakening Skills on PVP & PVE
Certain awakening system and skills will only be usable in dungeons. We are still reviewing the possibility of allowing awakening skills in PVP but only after awakening for all karmas are released.

Starting with Dungeon 4 in the 1st Region you will have the follow 2 methods of matchmaking.
-	Start with Current Members: You can enter a dungeon right away by yourself or with your current party members.
-	Queue Auto Party: After entering the queue, if there are other players, you can start the dungeon with 2 or 3 players. If there are no players found for a set duration, the minimum required player will drop to 1 and you can enter the dungeon by yourself.

PVE Growth Revamp
The difficulty of PVE dungeons (excluding Abyss) have been lowered and overall, the time required to level up your character have been shortened.
You will now be able to level up a lot quicker and the rewards have also been adjusted to meet the new growth speed.
