notes.title: January 13th 2021 Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Attention, Chasers!

Please check the weekly maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) January 13th,2021 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f7b7d13c0f3620931bac46f94e7a7bc114ee99b3.png

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

New System
•	Awakening System
-	New Awakening System is coming to KurtzPel! For this update, we will be bringing the awakening system to Sword Taliah & Dance of Wind.

-	How to unlock Awakening
Reach Lv.20 and Karma Lv.6 on your character, then you will be able to talk to the NPC inside Eltheca to receive the Awakening Quest. Once complete, you will receive an item that will unlock your awakening. These awakening quests can be complete by playing dungeons within your level range or can be unlocked by purchasing Awakening Tomes in the KP Shop.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/149ec57857d708488139dcaecd60d933680c9c04.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/6a906e705ba4904d430c6c5020d9b76978dbd3ca.jpg

-	Karma Skill Tree Expansion
When you unlock your awakening, you can level up your karma up to Lv.11 and you can become stronger with each level by acquiring passives or new skills.

Expanded Sword Taliah Skill Tree
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/541f4e3ee4792f5319eaf12365df2d5ec872678c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/45e7a32006ed16852bacf31f17ec2eb961789f6d.png

Expanded Dance of Wind Skill Tree
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/18b1f4c8a61a8e6a74dd98e6691e3657415a90e0.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/7b002a3fc030e201a8255f3322248d0d89f4cccd.png

With this update, all Karma's max level will be increased from 5 to 6 but only Sword Taliah & Dance of Wind will be able to reach Lv.11 through Awakening.

-	Awakening Gauge
Once you unlock your Awakening, you will be able to use the Awakening Gauge in dungeons.
Your awakening gauge will increase by dealing damage to monsters and the amount of gauge increased will depend on your damage. Once you have filled up your awakening gauge, you will be able to activate it with L-Alt key. When the Awakening Gauge is active, your movement speed, attack power, stamina recovery, and mana recovery will be increased for a set duration.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b41e61d4d15ef945c6499ba599587de803c7b0ca.jpg

When your Awakening is active, you can perfectly dodge an enemy's attack to slow everything around you and gain additional movement speed, action speed, mana/stamina/hp recovery increase buff.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/0ea7c511140451504e0a37a89c6f679d70435698.jpg

When you acquire the Awakening Rage Skill by hitting Lv.10 on your Karma, you will be able to use the Awakening Rage Skill by awakening with a full rage bar. The awakening rage skill must be used before the Awakening effect expires.

-	Effect of Awakening Skills on PVP & PVE
Certain awakening system and skills will only be usable in dungeons. We are still reviewing the possibility of allowing awakening skills in PVP but only after awakening for all karmas are released.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f4195ebf1d73854069b7fb920b59a1b7a47aa73b.png

•	Costume Set Effect System
-	Set effects for costumes will be added. Set options are additional effects that you can gain by having certain number of pieces equipped on your character. 
You can check the set effect by looking at the tooltip of costumes that has set effects.

Set Option Tooltip
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/4b7cdf9fc80a91c6c54dbcfe33c5ed20f39ce788.png

9-Piece Set Effect Activated
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/2d9681edad8cbe10ee92f8a7f222161dfa4f28ff.png

Improvement
•	Supply Box Usage Improvement
-	Before, you would have to walk towards the Supply Box in Eltheca in order to use the Supply Boxes you had. Now, you can simply right-click the supply box in your inventory to use it right away.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/50572439ac95f9bd2769fc71012211d7a8cf2f6a.png

You can also preview the content of the Supply Box from the KP Shop.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/16103eb86a1cd62b0671a464e894436c683a12b2.png

Event
•	New & Returning Chaser Attendance Event (Duration Until Further Notice)
-	New attendance event will categorize players in to two groups, new and returning.

o	New Chaser: Players who logged in to the game for the first time after the January 13th Update (Existing players who does not fall under the returning Chaser category will also fall under the New Chaser category for this event)
o	Returning: Existing Chasers who hasn't logged in to the game for more than 30 days

-	This attendance event will contain items such as [Eltheca] AP + 100% Boost (1 Day), [Eltheca] CP + 100% Boost (1 Day), [Eltheca] EXP + 100% Boost (1 Day), [Eltheca] Heroic Karma Token Select Cube, [Eltheca] Advanced Dye, [Eltheca] Resurrection Stone, Settia Outfit & Accessory Cube (Limited Time), [Eltheca] Item Sealing Scroll, [Eltheca] Character Appearance Change Ticket, [Eltheca] Inventory Expansion Ticket Selection Cube, and more!

Etc
•	Key Customization
-	Due to the release of the awakening system, your current keyboard customization will be reset. We suggest players take a screenshot of their current key binding to make resetting your key binding easy.


Bug Fix

notes.title: KurtzPel Upcoming Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Chasers

It's been a long time coming but we are finally here with some exciting news for the future of KurtzPel.

We have been hard at work to bring you a content update that would be impactful and meaningful to KurtzPel and we are finally here to tell you all about it.


New PVE Dungeons
We are changing the way you play PVE in KurtzPel with the all new PVE dungeons. You will go through sections of a dungeon and fight countless monsters along the way before fighting the boss at the end. 
[previewyoutube=cXHLeLW7-bM;full][/previewyoutube]

PVE Character Progression & PVE Equipment
Your character will now level up from gaining EXP from PVE dungeons and you will also receive PVE equipment from clearing dungeons or completing quests. PVE equipment will have different item grades with stats so you'll be able to optimize the perfect gear for your playstyle. Lastly, these new PVE equipment will not affect PVP in any way shape or form so you won't have to worry about feeling like you are forced to play either PVP or PVE.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/98165218679b7de5ce0b4f7c679d95eea70bc106.png

PVE Combat Mechanic Change
The combat mechanic and system in PVP will remain untouched but in order to make the PVE experience more fun and exciting, we are making some changes to how some of them work in PVE.
•	Movement will no longer cost Stamina (Dash & Evade)
•	Blazing Fist can now grab multiple enemies at once
•	Karma Switching attack will not have any cooldown
•	Chase Attack can now hit multiple targets (Lift up multiple enemies at once)
•	Cooldown on skills will be decreased
[previewyoutube=MITuDpdHXyY;full][/previewyoutube]

Potion System
Potions will be added to PVE. These potions will only work in PVE and can restore HP and MP. This will increase the amount of skill you can use during combat without feeling helpless once your HP or MP runs out.

Resurrection System
You will now be able to resurrect not only yourself but your allies using your resurrection stones. This is also a PVE only feature.

Quest System
We are adding a Quest System to share the lore and story of KurtzPel to our fellow Chasers. The quest system will not only serve as a mean to expand the story of KurtzPel but also to work as a guide for players to continue their PVE progression. There will also be helpful items provided as a reward for completing certain quests.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/da7b4dddf9cd816ae23120fddf35f7fec1ce9ac2.png

Story
You can now discover the story of KurtzPel by playing through the new PVE dungeons. As you clear more dungeons, you will find more about the dungeons and the region they are in.
[previewyoutube=qanpxZVV7D0;full][/previewyoutube]

We will also work on the following for the future:
•	Challenging PVE Content
•	Continued update of dungeons & Karma
•	Continued update of Character and Equipment growth
•	New PVP Modes
•	Updates that impact the stale PVP meta

Please note that the video and screenshot shown above is not final and can differ from the final product.

We hope you are excited about the upcoming changes and we hope to bring it to you as soon as possible. Please continue to support us and send us your valuable feedback.
We will continue to update everyone as soon as we have more news about KurtzPel's future contents.

Lastly, the above content will be coming to KurtzPel before the end of November 2020.

Thank you.

New Karma - Lightning Fang

Name: Lightning Fang
Weapon: Kunai
Type: Mid-Range, Slayer

Lightning Fang is a magic slayer that uses a Kunai as its main weapon.
Lightning Fang can use the Kunai to distract the enemy from afar and can dish out big damage when the enemy becomes vulnerable. Due to Lightning Fang's mobility and the ability to blink a certain distance, this Karma will be a biggest threat to long-ranged Karmas.

PVP Season 6
Ranks for Season 6 will be based on your rank from Season 5.
All ranks will be decreased by 3.
The highest rank at the start of the season is B1 and the lowest is D1.
However, all E ranks will be reset to E1.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f20a338a4aa8020189e70a4d0de47f545f173547.png

New System - Decks
You can now preset your load-out with the all-new Deck system.
The deck system will be applied for Karma / Equipment / Emote can there can be a total of 3 Decks each.
In order to open additional deck slots, you need to have an item that unlocks the slots. (Can be purchased from the KP Shop)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/8eb7495475684ef318abe1cf6fd253389072130f.jpg

Method B - Use the Deck Open Ticket item in your inventory
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a971c8a3faf3f57b6c34231ff6d12cf757755080.jpg

Opened Deck Example (Equipment)
After opening your deck slot, set the equipment you would like to use.
The items you selected will be the items that will be used when you select your deck.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f415ae2496ca50fc0672ef3c24b2e6ff882ee145.jpg

notes.title: July 15th 2020 Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Attention, Chasers!

Please check the weekly maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) July 15th,2020 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/0ff330d9fcb2908d1e7ad95793ac2bcc63a0b803.png

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

New Karma
Name: Aegis Knight
Weapon: Sword & Shield
Type: Melee, Physical, Breaker

Aegis Knight uses a Sword & Shield as its weapon of choice and is a physical based Breaker.
This Karma can use the Sword & Shield to be aggressive or defensive with ease. Aegis Knight can also apply a buff to their teammates to fortify them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/978039b8a0dbe3d7172e4fd0337b0fb3ddae9612.png

PVP Season 5
Season 5's starting ranks will depend on your rank from Season 4.
All ranks will be decreased by 3 and the highest rank possible at the start of Season 5 is B1 and the lowest is D1.
However, E Ranks will all be reset to E1.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/3301dd7348f57f8edae1af3be99397cb71e3b50b.png

New Rank
The point of the rank system is to give a goal for the players to work towards and also to give them a sense of accomplishment. We also wanted the rank to be an indicator of a player's skill.
In Season 1, we felt the ranks gave players more despair than accomplishments due to rank decreases from losses and made players lose interest in the PVP of KurtzPel. Because of that, we decided to not let ranks fall until a player has reached a certain rank.
In Season 4, we hoped to have made the queue times shorter than with the increased number of players in S Rank.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/eb585471fab53b32d7fb14325caa82f75a0d1592.jpg

Due to the increase of S and G rank players, we wanted to improve the ranks by adding a new M Rank to the system.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/30447902dd901c141cf2cd45dd074733a8c1e21c.jpg

•	M Rank will allow players to understand the proper skill level of a high-ranking player.
•	For players that were having a hard time going from S to G, M rank will give them a shorter-term goal to work towards on their path to G rank

Rating Placement Segment Increase
Due to the presence of Promo Matches, there were a lot of players having a hard time ranking up due to losing their Promo Matches constantly. Many players stopped climbing at a certain point due to the stress of ranking down.

•	From S1 ~ G3 Rank, your ranking will now be reflected by your rating placement.
•	For Ranks S1 and higher, your rating will decrease if you don't play any matches for a certain period
•	Your character info and leaderboard placement will be shown starting from A Rank

AI Matchmaking for Certain Ranks
In low rating area, if your matchmaking takes too long, you will be matched with AI bots with the skill appropriate for your current rank.

Rank Related Feedback Increase
•	You will now be able to see your rank and progress while inside Eltheca
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/db48b232b6860e9de9febf9582f0b2df243b5ea6.jpg

•	If your next match is your promo match, it will be shown inside the Mission Map window
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f2879a622506e2eb45db68b844e41d55401eba3b.jpg

•	At the start of your promo match, your promo info will be shown
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/efd707e273e21ad33aa04ec9abae88b61e2fdbac.jpg

•	When your rank is changed, the presentation in the result screen will be improved{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/9f265d196e4fe843fc7307647fe3891cc6bfbece.jpg

Karma Balance
General
Combo Damage Limit Increased

Removed the system multiple Chase prevention system where it makes the attacked player get knocked down when they are attacked by Chase attack too often in a set duration

Fixed the error with Siege Mode and Salvo Arrow not activating immediately after casting at certain times

Basic Movement Speed Changed for Karmas
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/90aa6ea2e0a7ef852533647af03fd96ca00700a4.png

Sacred Guardian
While charging RMB, LMB attack damage will be decreased by 50% (Break Damage will remain the same)
RMB Attack's first attack timing will be activated at the time of smashing the hammer. (Slower by 0.4 sec.)

Gigantic Swing
-	Damage Decreased by 30% (Break Damage Unchanged)
-	Stun Duration Decreased from 2 sec. to 1 sec.
-	Break Damage decreased by 30%

Crusade Endurance Increased by 50%
Movement Speed decreased by 35% while holding down RMB

Dance of Wind
Binding Arrow
-	Break Damage decreased by 30%
-	Won't be able to break the Breakers normal endurance

LMB Command Attack's Break Damage decreased by 50%
RMB Charge Attack's Break Damage Removed
LMB RMB RMB attack won't have increased break damage even if it is charged
LMB RMB RMB attack's final projectile distance decreased
LMB LMB RMB attack's final projectile distance decreased

Salvo Arrow
-	Follow-Up Arrow's mana cost is decreased by 35%

Fallen Light
LMB and RMB Command attack's Break Damage decreased by 50%

Slug Shot
-	Projectile's distance and knockback distance decreased

Atomic Blast
-	You will no longer be able to Rage Break while being attacked

Soul of Magus
LMB and RMB Command attack's Break Damage decreased by 50%

Sword Taliah
Leap
-	Break Damage increased by 20%

Blazing Fist
Instant Chase
-	Break Damage increased by 30%

Ruler of Darkness
Decreased the strength of pull by 50%

Rising Wings
-	Endurance increased by 50%

Death Hold
-	Endurance decreased by 50%

Demon Rush
-	Endurance decreased by 50%

Etc.
•	Season Pass can now be progressed using PVE
-	Daily and Weekly Challenges for the Season Pass will no longer solely depend on playing PVP. You will now be able to complete your challenges using PVP or PVE. 
Starting from Season 5, you will be able to complete your Daily and Weekly Challenges by only playing PVE missions.

•	Capture The Crystal (CTC) will be removed from Beta

•	Exchange CP option will be removed while you are inside the Trading Post window.
-	We felt the function to Exchange an item to CP while you are inside the Trading Post window was not necessary and decided to remove it. You can still exchange your items for CP in your normal item window.

Events
•	Aegis Knight is Here! (UTC+0 2020-07-15 05:00 - 2020-07-29 05:00)
-	During the Event Period, play using the Aegis Knight Karma to receive 30% additional AP, CP, and DP.

•	Attendance Event (UTC+0 2020-07-15 05:00 - 2020-08-26 05:00)
-	Log in to the game during the Event Period to receive items such as Radiant Magic Stone, Advanced Dye, Advanced Supply Box, Salute Emote and more!

notes.notes:

Maintenance will happen during the following times:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f2b05e8cb24c8095d3ee8bc6a4dbfe2e96eb6889.png

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

Balance
•	Sword Taliah
-	Stun Hit's additional attack input timing has been moved to the point the attack finishes hitting
-	Dash Attack's launch angle will now be the same regardless of when the attack registers as a hit

•	Dance of Wind
-	Fixed the bug with dash automatically activating if you hold down your direction key after evading
-	Dash Attack and LMB + LMB + RMB attack's Chase Attack will now activate at the 1st hit instead of 2nd hit
-	Break Damage for RMB Charge attack decreased

•	Sacred Guardian
-	Removed auto-targeting from RMB Charge attack's 2nd hit
-	Gigantic Swing's stun duration increased from 1 sec. to 2 sec.

•	Fallen Light
-	Increased maximum ammo capacity to 9
-	Fallen Light will now start with full ammo at the start of the match
-	Basic Combo and RMB combo can now be used while moving
-	Basic Combo's 3rd hit will now fire rapid shots at all times
-	Increased hit box size and projectile speed of rapid shot

•	Dual Soul
-	Demon Mode can no longer be used while being attacked
-	Demon Mode can now be detected from 1200 instead of 700

•	Ruler of Darkness
-	Aerial RMB 1st Hit will now use more stacks from 1 to 3

•	Blazing Fist
-	Instant Chase will no longer be able to break Crusade & Rising Wings

•	Soul of Magus
-	Communion's Attack Speed Increase is decreased from 15% to 10%
-	Communion's additional hit attack power decreased

Revamp
•	Basic Control Revamp 

-	Blow System
o	Sword Taliah, Blazing Fist, Dual Soul, Sacred Guardian, and Ruler of Darkness will now be able to utilize this system.
o	Ground and Aerial LMB combo's last hit will now apply the Blow status to the attacked enemy. This system will make it easier to follow up on your combo after your final LMB hit.

-	Pause Commands Input Method removed
o	Pause Commands for Sword Taliah, Dance of Wind, Diabolic Witch, Blazing Fist, Dual Soul and Sacred Guardian will no longer require the pause. You can now simply hold down LMB to execute these commands

-	Command Attacks will no longer consume stamina

-	Combo Limit Gauge function added
o	When you are attacked continuously in a combo, your combo limit gauge will start to increase and once it fills up 100%, emergency dodge will be activated. Emergency Dodge will let you escape from a combo by knocking you out of it.

-	Accumulated Combo Damage Reduction function added 
o	When the combo damage accumulates to a certain number, damage that is delivered after that point will be decreased.

•	Rage Skill Revamp
-	Rage Skill's animation is simplified and revamped


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b7b74261f7e06489be39742278b218f26115ca92.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/4798ee13d579f2ca14a855e16e29fbbaa542fe36.jpg


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/826d149ff9bfe81167ba319e9be04d8ad89b9537.jpg


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f65d7b700ee2e3dec2d2b7359bd71fbe454a438a.jpg

Improvement
•	Deathmatch Mode Improvement
-	As players were getting higher in rank, more players were participating in playing passive and doing a hit and run.
-	Deathmatch will no longer have a countdown for match end and instead a team must reach a certain kill count in order to win
-	Deathmatch's objective score increased from 5 to 10
-	A forcefield will be added to deathmatch that will slowly decrease in size as time passes.
This will stop most players from playing passively until time runs out and Breakers will become more useful.

•	Conquest & Capture The Flag Mode Improvement
-	Conquest and CTF will now provide scores for slaying your enemy, meaning the role of Slayers will matter a bit more in these two modes.
Which should also deter away from teams having the same score and making the match longer.
-	Conquest & CTF will now provide score for slaying enemies
o	CTF: Score Objective - 500 (30 Pts per Kill | 100 Pts per Flag Capture)
o	Conquest: Score Objective - 500 (30 Pts per Kill | 1 Pts per 1 Sec of Capture)

•	Improving Penalty for Canceling Matchmaking (Force Shutdown)
-	Force Closing the game while in the ready phase of choosing Karma will be considered Match Canceling
-	Match canceling multiple times will now apply matchmaking penalty and decrease in ratings

•	Game Frame Rate Optimization applied

Event
•	Aegis Knight Pre-Release Event (UTC+0 2020-07-08 After Maintenance - 2020-07-15 Before Maintenance)
-	During the Event Period, login in each day for 60 min to receive a 'Aegis Knight Gift Box'
o	You can receive 1 Box per Day
o	However, it is only limited to 1 Server Per Account (Example: If you receive the box on a Character in America server, you cannot receive this again is EU or Asia)
o	Please note that all unused Aegis Knight Gift Boxes will be deleted during the UTC+0 2020-07-15 Maintenance

-	Aegis Knight Gift Box Contents (1 Random out of Below)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/48122dd917f6913ccb9dd6ce91e8d8df942bb477.png

•	Fixed the bug with Tome of Knowledge not playing any sound or playing the wrong sound

Tournament System Beta
An all new Tournament System (Beta) will be added to KurtzPel.
Tournament System is a new system where multiple players fight against each other until a winner is born.
Before this becomes an official system / content for KurtzPel, we are releasing it in Beta form first to work out the kinks and polish it.
Do not be afraid to give us your feedback about the Tournament System.

Beta Duration
UTC+0 2020-05-20 – Until 2020-06-03 Maintenance

Tournament System Testing Time
At 20:00 for Each Server
America - 20:00 PDT
Europe - 20:00 CEST
Asia - 20:00 JST

How it Works
When the set time for the Tournament System comes, a notification will go out.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/867f44490d9ab225326f7c11f02aa0dafbb6c5e6.jpg

You can then enter the Tournament UI by accessing the Mission Window (M Key).
You can participate in the tournament by clicking to Register for Tournament.
If you have a partner you want to participate with, make sure to party up with them before you register to participate. You can also choose to do it alone as well.
The tournament registration period will last for 30 min and during that time, you can either enter the Training Grounds or Participate in other missions.
However, please make sure you are inside the Eltheca Lobby before the 30 min is up.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/46751e62b828c83ac97ab6750218a023666c4dcb.jpg

When the registration period runs out, you will be prompted to confirm whether you will participate in the tournament. Press Participate if you are sure.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/c49042bae36f2d9723d8209f1029bff45226e865.jpg

Once you are successful in participating, your bracket and success message will pop up.
If you registered alone, you will automatically be matched with a partner that is equal to your skill level.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f8499b47817202a11493774565d6001fb44d0c61.jpg

When your opponent is chosen, best of 16 matches will begin.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/2e77e0c070c0e24503153a7400683eb9f159d729.jpg

When you are victorious, the matches will begin again with whoever won first.
Best of 8 matches will begin with whoever wins first.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f4ee1cdde281502477f9350e4e77931ebff235a4.jpg

While you wait for your match, you can press on your enemy’s name to check their info.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/1524d4bc49c70e036cef254120624b3c83f61778.jpg

When the winner of the Tournament is decided, a server wide announcement will go out that notifies the winner of the highest tier tournament.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/4a1f51a399cfe5ee6299f9f2ddac209225c05d16.jpg

The winner will have a trophy icon proving their victory beside their name in Eltheca.
This trophy icon will last until the next winner of the Tournament is born.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/134cf38a7ea8ea603ce23229313f8fbb4bc3a411.jpg

Hall of Fame
When you click on the Hall of Fame, you can check the most recent winners.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/81c314fe5eb75470b49aa0c111b776becf6a4aa1.jpg

You can click “View Brackets” to check the bracket status when they won.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/02d1864ab641c1ecca27e0cd069da9d36873e4e6.jpg

If you want to check your own records, you can click on My Record to view your previous brackets and result.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/99bea820e4e0ef30debf9079dd03cd28d81bc785.jpg

Click on “Recent Record” to see your previous Tournament Matches, Brackets, and results.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/7511e6c56605a8a222ee6c38ca74738882535300.jpg

When the match time goes over 10 min, the winner will be decided under the following rule.
-	Death Match: Team with the most HP wins. If HP is equal for both teams, the team with the most accumulated damage dealt will win.
-	Capture the Flag: Team with the most accumulated damage dealt will win. If the dealt damage is the same, the team with the highest HP will win.

Improvement
•	Conquest Score Objective changed from 500 to 300

Balance
•	PVE
o	Scout Mission Difficulty Adjusted

•	General
o	Chase Attack Activation Requirement Improved
Bow, Staff, and Orb's Chase Attack will now activate regardless of the distance between you and the enemy.

o	Dash Control Improvement
Fixed an issue with Dash activating even when you didn't press double tap

o	Evade i-frame Improved
All Karmas will now have the same duration of i-frame after evading.
invincibility frame will wear off once you start moving after evading

o	Knockdown Duration
In order to promote more offensive gameplay, knockdown duration has been decreased.
-	Max Knockdown duration decreased from 2.5 sec. to 1 sec.
-	Minimum Knockdown duration decreased from 1.5 sec. to 0.5 sec.

•	Soul of Magus
o	Dimension Leap
Skill Radius and Damage Increased, Animation Duration Decreased

o	Heart Stopper
Damage Increased

o	Unleash Spirit
Buff Duration will now be refreshed when the skill is used again during its duration
The buff will remain even when you switch your Karma

o	Communion
Buff duration will be refreshed when the skill is used again during the duration

o	Shadow Pull
Break Damage Decreased

o	Spirit Rain
Break Damage Decreased
Flinch Decreased
Being Hit in the air will make the enemy fall to the floor

•	Dance of Wind
o	Binding Arrow
Skill will now activate even if you quickly press left mouse click in ready stance

•	Dual Soul
o	Basic Combo
Stability of hitting an enemy that's in the air has been improved
-	Basic Combo 1st & 3rd Hit will hit higher
-	Multi-Stab will now slowly push back enemies
-	Basic Combo's 5th Hit's Hit Stop has been removed

o	Rend
Skill's Vertical Range has been increased

•	Ruler of Darkness
o	Aerial Right Click
Endurance will be decreased to match the Aerial Left Click

o	Shadow Slash
Endurance Increased by 50%
When you hit an enemy with Shadow Slash, you can move cancel faster to follow up with a combo

o	Soul Taker
Move Cancel timing during Soul Taker will be delayed

o	Rising Wings
You will now charge to the direction of your character facing
In order to increase the risk of missing the skill, if you miss your attack, your endurance will drop back down immediately once the attack motion stops
Aerial Hit Duration Decreased from 1 sec. to 0.7 sec.

o	Death Hold
In order to make it easier to follow up with a combo, once you hit an enemy, you can dash cancel
Activating Resource Cost decreased from 50 to 30
Damage and Break Damage Decreased (You will no longer be able to break attacks with highest endurance)

o	Dark Mist
Damage and Break Damage Decreased (You will no longer be able to break attacks with highest endurance)

o	Demon Rush
Skill will be adjusted to deal damage and continue combos instead of breaking an enemy
Damage Increased by 64%
Break Damage Decreased
Made it easier to follow up with a combo but hard to break enemies with just this skill alone
When using the skill, you will now be able to aim

Changes
•	Skills that is acquired at default will no longer be tradable.

Bug Fix
•	Fixed an error with Dual Soul’s weapon becoming bigger after using a certain Emote
•	Fixed a visual error after using Spirit Rain, your skills will look like it is available to use when it is not
•	Fixed an error with Orb’s left mouse click command and movement key would randomly trigger a dash
•	Fixed an error with Orb’s Heart Stopper skill not following the intended direction when firing
•	Fixed an error with Diabolic Witch able to become invisible using certain environment

New Karma Released

Name: Soul of Magus
Weapon: Orb
Type: Long-Range, Slayer

Soul of Magus is a long-range magic slayer that uses an orb as a weapon.
The orb has a power and movement of its own that is separate from the wielder and is very versatile.
Your combat style will change depending on how you want to utilize the orb.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/038133f93a15c080e8f1dac6b66ba973aad7e3e6.png

PVP Season 4
Your Season 4 Rank will be soft reset depending on your rank from Season 3.
All ranks will be decreased by 3.
The highest rank you can acquire after the reset is B1 and the lowest is D1.
For E ranks, you will automatically be set to E1 regardless of which stage you were at.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/496058e9ffde7c7d3a264a6ca81dc7607c4e11c7.png

Also, starting with Season 4, there will no longer be challenges that requires a Chaser to reach a certain interrupt or damage. In order to implement these, all the daily and weekly challenges that were in progress will be reset.

Consecutive Win Rating Bonus Limit
When calculating the player's rating, you will no longer receive rating bonus for more than 10 consecutive wins. Originally, our plan for the consecutive win bonus was for the good player to advance their rating fast to fight other players at their skill level but there were cases where the bonus rating was getting out of hand. 

Party Rating Calculation Revamp
Party Rating calculation will no longer take the individual ranking of the party member. Instead, the rating will solely be calculated by the individual member's rating. We decided to change it this way because starting with Season 3, players were able to reach a certain rank by playing a lot and we didn't want to calculate the wrong skill rating depending on their rank.

Fixed Maximum Match Rating
When a party or an individual player hits a certain rating, their matchmaking rating will be set to a fixed amount.
This is in order to reduce the matchmaking time for players with too high of a rating.
This maximum rating might change in the future depending on how it works out.

Balance
1.	General
-	Rage Gain according to HP Increase Adjusted
	Due to the HP Increase Option Stat, players were able to use more Rage skills before death. We thought this was too overpowered and decided to decrease its efficiency in order to create diversity in meta.
	You will gain less rage depending on your HP Increase Stats

-	Defense Stats Equation Adjusted
	We changed up the Defense stats equation in order for Slayers to deal more damage to Breakers but deal less damage to Slayers.
	Breaker's Physical and Magical Defense Decreased
	Slayer's Physical and Magical Defense Increased

-	Movement Speed Difference Between Karmas Adjusted
	In order to lessen the impact of choosing Karmas based on movement speed, we increased the movement speed for Karmas with slower movement speed.
	Target Karma Movement Speed: Dance of Wind +3%, Diabolic Witch +11%, Sacred Guardian +9%, Fallen Light +9%, Ruler of Darkness +9%
	Certain Karmas had their evade and skills balanced around the slower movement speed, so their function will also be balanced in the future.

2.	Dance of Wind
-	LMB + RMB + RMB Attack
	In order to lessen the distance of you with the target, you can now use this attack while moving forward
	Evade + RMB + RMB will be changed the same way
	LMB + RMB + RMB charge time decreased from 1.5 sec. to 0.7 sec.
	When you charge up and use your LMB + RMB + RMB attack, it will count as a Chase Attack
	Fixed the LMB + RMB + RMB attack going through the enemy when it is used in a close distance
	LMB + RMB + RMB attack's arrow projectile speed decreased by 50% but will move the same distance as before

-	Siege Mode
	When taking the Siege Mode stance, increase the attack radius and launch height distance
	When using consecutive Siege Mode attacks, the attack delay will be decreased by 50%
	No charge damage decreased by 17%
	Resource Cost Decreased from 30 to 25

-	Raining Arrows
	Maintaining the attack duration by holding LMB function will be removed
	After activating Raining Arrows, you will be able to move cancel and the Raining Arrow skill effect will continue to linger, enabling you to follow up with a combo
	Decreased the dropping effect of Raining Arrows when hitting enemies in the air

-	Great Archer's Soul
	In order to quickly activate the skill and follow up with an attack, removed the dynamic camera effect and decreased the time it takes to activate the first attack from 2.3 sec. to 0.8 sec.
	Attack Speed Increase Effect Decreased 1.5 times to 1.2 times
	Projectile's duration and range increased from 1.8 times to 2.5 times
	Endurance Multiplier Increased from 1.2 times to 1.5 times

3.	Diabolic Witch
-	Meteor
	The time it takes for stop time effect to kick in has been increased from 0.4 sec. to 0.5 sec.

4.	Dual Soul
-	Hit Stop Removed
	LMB 1, 2 3, 4 Hit
	Multi-Stab Command
	Dash Attack
	Evade Attack
	Moon Slash, Critical Slash, Spinning Strike

5.	Blazing Fist
-	Reckless Charge
	You will no longer be able to Evade out while dragging an enemy

-	Whirlwind
	You will no longer be able to Evade out while spinning an enemy

-	Falling Star
	The time it takes for stop time effect to kick in has been increased from 0.3 sec. to 0.5 sec.

-	Ultimate Heat
	Fixed the issue with Ultimate Heat activating the wrong direction when there are no enemies being targeted

6.	Sacred Guardian
-	Dash Jump
	You can now activate the Hammer Jump command by Dash + RMB instead of activating it with RMB while dash sprinting.

-	Ultimate Hammer
	The time it takes for stop time effect to kick in has been increased from 0.4 sec. to 0.5 sec.

7.	Fallen Light
-	LMB + LMB + LMB Command
	This attack will now auto target

-	Rapid Shot Command
	Adjusted the timing to make it easier to activate

-	Evade Attack
	Aerial LMB & Aerial RMB will now activate attacks faster in order to make it easier to follow up with combos

-	Aerial LMB + LMB + LMB + LMB
	When using the final smash attack, the attack will now register in the air as well
	The final smash attack will stun the enemy on the ground for 1.5 sec.
	You will be able to follow up easier with Aerial RMB + RMB + RMB

-	Aerial RMB + RMB
	You can now follow up with Aerial LMB + LMB combo
	Your Aerial RMB + RMB + RMB will become faster with higher attack speed

-	Lightning Shot
	Lightning Shot will no longer suck in allies 

8.	Ruler of Darkness
-	Evade Attack & Dark Mist
	Particle Effect has been added to invisible effect in order to enemies to know the general movement of Ruler of Darkness

1.	New Karma - Ruler of Darkness
Name: Ruler of Darkness
Weapon: Soul Scythe
Type: Close-Range, Breaker

Ruler of Darkness is an INT based breaker that uses a soul scythe.
A tiny ancient demon is sealed within the soul scythe.
When you successfully attack using command attacks, you will gain special resources. Use the special resources with the right-click combo in order summon a demon for special combo attacks.

2.	New Mode: Capture the Crystal (CTC)
A new mode has been added in PvP [Duel] Mode.
Obtain crystals to gain points for the team. The objective of this mode is to collect and steal as many crystals as possible.
The crystals will appear periodically around the map.
The number of crystals you obtain will influence the points you obtain.
When you are knocked out, all the crystals you own will drop and the team will lose points based on the number of crystals you had at the time.
The opponent can take the crystals that are dropped, or your ally can collect them as well.

Once a team reaches the required point to win, a countdown will start until the team’s victory.
The opposing team can prevent the victory by defeating the winning team’s members and cause them to drop the crystals, which will stop the victory countdown.
There’s always a chance to turn the tide by stealing the opponent team’s crystals.

How to Enter: Have a chance to appear when queueing for PvP Duel Mode. (D rank or higher)
Match Type: 3 vs 3

New Mode: Survival
Survival mode is a free for all PVP mode that can only be entered during a specific time and can have up to 10 players at once.
The goal of this mode is to become the last Chaser standing.

There will be 7 different Buff Crystals that appear constantly all around the map in order to help with your survival.
Each time you acquire a buff, you get powerful buffs and recover your health, this will work in your favor in order to survive.
From time to time, a [Special Buff] Crystal will appear and whoever acquires this Special Buff will recover health by finishing off an opponent. This buff will allow the Chaser to have a better chance to be the last Chaser standing!

As time goes by, the area will shrink, making the battle more chaotic as time goes by.

Max Participants: 10 Players (Minimum 8 Players)
Available Time: (First 20 min of Each Hour) XX:00 ~ XX:19 (20 min)
(When the available time passes, your matchmaking will be canceled. However, Chasers who are already in a match will continue on)

Trading Post System

Item Option Swap System
'Item Option Swap Ticket' will allow the player to swap the item option from one item to another. You can swap the 2 options on an equipment to another identical equip slot item. 
-	Ex: 2 Item Option on Shoes  2 Item Option on Another Shoes
Option Swap tickets can be created using the Synthesis System or receive them as a bonus by purchasing packages and the item swap tickets will be included with the same number of items inside the package.

For players who experienced PVP rating decay on Feb 7th 2020 will have their lost rating recovered after this maintenance.

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

Due to the amount of changes being implemented in to the game, our maintenance will start earlier than usual and last for 5 hours.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/fabc7eaaa77c890ba574905c8c28c529ee16d3a2.png

1.	New Karma (Fallen Light) 
Name: Fallen Light
Weapon: Elemental Buster
Type: Long-Range Magic Slayer
Unlike previous long-range Karmas, Fallen Light's basic attacks does not have auto aim assistance. Whether or not your basic attack lands on your opponent will solely depend on your aim. 
Fallen Light also utilizes a new resource called "Magic Bullet" and this resource can be used to enhance your skills or deliver a stronger attack.

2.	New 5 vs 5 PVP
New 5 vs 5 Maps will be added to enjoy PVP with more Chasers at once. 
In order to accommodate the large-scale battle, the 5 vs 5 maps will be bigger and Conquest Mode map will have 2 Capture Points. There will be a total of 2 Deathmatch and 1 Conquest Maps for 5 vs 5.

3.	PVP Season 2 
In order to make PVP more enjoyable with Season 2, we've made some changes. 

- Matchmaking
We wanted to test various skills of Chasers and reflect that on their PVP rank. Not just their ability to defeat enemies but also strategies and teamwork. To implement this change, Chasers will now be matched to a random mode. However, once Chasers are matched to a mode, they will have the option to change their Karma & skills before the match starts.

- Rewards
In Season 1, many Chasers decided not to play after reaching a certain rank in fear of ranking down at the end of the Season. In order to encourage players to continue and climb their ranks, we are rewarding the Season end reward based on the highest reached by the Chaser during the Season. Also, to commemorate the higher ranked achieved by Chasers, we are improving the visuals of the Symbol of A, S and G Rank.

- PVP Mission
Duel Mission is a 3 vs 3 or 5 vs 5 PVP mission that doesn't have any rank downs and can be used to safely reach A3 rank. Challenge Mission is the classic 2 vs 2 PVP mission that allows Chasers to rank up past A3 and this mode will have rank downs. 

- Rank & Rating 
Increasing your Rank is fun but at the same time, it could be stressful due to ranking down and losing. In order to relieve some of that stress and have many people enjoy ranking up, we are going to change some things. First, we will make ranks up to A3 achievable by anyone as long as they keep playing. Also, we are reducing the number of stages required per rank to rank up from 5 to 3 in order to make the Promo match occur much faster.

4.	Season Pass System
We are now adding a Season Pass system on top of the existing Season Challenge system. When the Season Pass is activated, players will acquire additional rewards for increasing their Season Levels. The Season Pass will provide rewards that are worth much more than the price of activating the Season Pass.

5.	CP Shop
A new CP Shop run by Crim inside Eltheca will be added. Chasers will be able to purchase various items using the CP shop. 

6.	KP Shop
New In-Game KP Shop has been added. KP is a premium currency that can be acquired by using the Steam Wallet and players will be able to purchase the previous DLC products using the in-game UI with ease. 
Chasers will also be able to try out the items before purchasing inside the KP shop.

7.	New Growth System
Max level of Karmas will be increased and Karmas will now level up in a different way. Each time you level up your Karma, skills locked behind a certain Karma level will be unlocked. Once the skills are unlocked, players will be able to learn those skills using set currencies. Once a Karma reaches a set level, players will be able to apply additional stats to it.

8.	Mail System
Rewards from various content and events will be now be distributed through the in-game mail system. Players will now be able to check their mailbox inside Eltheca. Mail inside the mailbox will stay inside until a set expiration date is reached and once claimed, the item will be moved to the Chaser's inventory. 

9.	Gender Specific Items
In order to create various item designs, we are separating the Genders of Items to Male & Female. Already existing items in the game will not be affected. 

10.	Karma Acquisition Method Change
Karmas that were available to acquire through DLC will now be changed so that players can acquire it with 100 CP. 
From this point on, everyone will be able to acquire all Karmas with ease. 

11.	Inventory Revamp
From our previous system of using the Equipment Window and Steam Inventory, we are fully converting the Inventory to in-game UI. Chasers will now be able to check and equip items inside the new Inventory and also sell it for CP. 

12.	Extraction System Revamp 
Items acquired from Extraction will be changed. All previously acquired from Extraction will be changed to new items.

New Extraction Items
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/941406b90f627fefae8b71a90321635c1b3ce373.jpg

13.	Synthesis Revamp
Dyes, PVE Accessories and Supply Box contents will be removed from Synthesis. Instead, items that can be synthesized with Probatio Marks will be added. Previously acquired Synthesis items will be exchanged to new items.

Exchanged Items
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/1cccef46de4da4b5ad68291b48b079b47b8f3bd0.jpg

14.	Categories for Accessory and Outfit Change
Outfit Category: Top, Bottom, Right Hand, Left Hand, Shoes and Undergarment
Accessory Category: Hair Top, Hair Bottom, Face, Top, Face Bottom, Neck, Back and Belt

15.	Item Option Change System
Sub Stats from existing Accessories will be removed. Instead, players will be able to change the stat options of Karma, Weapon, Outfit, and Accessories by using Magic Stones or Radiant Magic Stones. Chasers will now be able to customize their characters even more with more option stats to add to different items. 
Existing Weapon and Outfit will have their stats changed to the highest upgrade and Sub Stats from Accessories will be changed to the highest possible option stat for the new system. Lastly, weapon's karma and sub karma slots will be unlocked to full. 

16.	Basic Stat Change & Removal
Previously, it was difficult to pinpoint bugs and balance based on Stat changes. In order to remedy this, we are removing the basic stat change system. Basic Stat change system that was available through Rebirth & Tome of Knowledge will be removed and every Chaser will now be fixed to 5/5/5/5/5 stats.

17.	Affinity System Removed
Previous Affinity system where it allowed Chasers to track and raise affinity with an NPC for rewards has been removed. Players who were still trying to acquire the reward for certain NPC affinity will be given all rewards for it as long as they have the corresponding Karma already unlocked. However, this does not apply to Crim & Ensher.

18.	PVE Revamp
PVE will be separated in to 3 different modes.
Difficulty setting per mission will be removed and each new mode will have a Karma Lv. restriction. Also, new modes will only allow manual resurrection.

-Patrol: You and 2 other allies will fight a random humanoid monster
-Annihilation: You and 3 other allies will fight multiple random monsters
-Raid: You and 5 other allies will fight a designated boss monster.

19.	Eltheca Visual Revamp

notes.title: Dev Note: KurtzPel Massive Update & Revamp
notes.notes:
Hello Chasers, this is the KurtzPel Team.

The year 2020 is finally upon us and KurtzPel will go through massive changes and have new content. Please check below for the info.

New Content

New Karma - Fallen Light
This new Karma is a magic cannon named "Elemental Buster" and takes on the role of a long-range magic slayer. Unlike other long-range Karmas, this Karma does not gain any auto-targeting assistance and all shot projectiles will follow the player's aim.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/727bc5e8e7ab52b3e4dc8785252d40a021df5c92.jpg

PVP Season 2
In order to judge the Chaser's ability on many different aspects of PVP, Chasers will no longer be able to select certain modes when matchmaking.
However, once you are matched with your opponents, there will be a new system where you will be able to change your weapon and skills before the match starts.

The reward system for PVP Season 2 will also change. Before, players were afraid of their ranks decreasing during the season and stopped to do Official Probatio after reaching a certain rank. From Season 2, players will be rewarded based on the highest ranking achieved during the season, so you no longer have to be afraid of ranking down and continue to try your best to achieve the highest rank.

Lastly, the emblem shown beside the players' name for ranks A, S, and G will be different to highlight the high ranks the players achieved.

PVP Missions
PVP Missions will no longer be separated by Practice and Official Probatio. Instead, they will now be separated to Duel Mission and Challenge Missions.
Duel Missions will match players with 3 ~ 5 vs PVP and there will be no rank decreases upon losing a match. However, because of that, players will only be able to reach up to Rank A in this mode. There will also be new and bigger maps to accommodate the 5 vs 5. 
2 New Deathmatch Maps and 1 new Conquest Maps will be added.

Challenge Missions will be the classic 2 vs 2 format and you can rank up and rank down just like before. In order for players to reach ranks higher than A, they must play on this mode.

New System & Existing System Update

Acquiring Karma
New and existing Chasers will now be able to acquire Dual Soul and Sacred Guardian Karma with reduced CP cost.

For players who already purchased the Dual Soul and Sacred Guardian Karma, after the update, you will receive your current Karma's Level + 1.

New Karma Growth System
The max growth of Karma will be increased from 3 to 5. You will also learn new skills through the new Karma UI instead of from certain Karma NPCs. Chasers will be able to learn new skills and abilities by leveling up their Karma.
For players who already have all the skills unlocked, they will have their skill items removed and have all those removed skills applied to the new Karma Growth System.

Character Inventory
A new inventory function and UI will be added. Players will now be able to check all their items in a convenient UI.

Mailbox System
A new mailbox system will be added. This system will be mainly used for sending out Event rewards or compensations for certain inconveniences.

PVP Ranks and Rating
As fun as it is to rank up to a higher rank, we found that many players felt frustrated whenever they lost. In order to assist with this, we will be decreasing the amount of points upon losing a match and also decreased the number of stages required to rank up to 3 instead of 5.

Season Pass
We have added a Season Pass to the existing Season Level system.
When your Battle Pass is activated, you will receive additional rewards while also receiving the rewards for Season Level. The Season Pass will provide greater rewards than the purchase price such as Season Pass Exclusive Costumes and Weapons.

New Currency - DP
A new currency called DP will be added. This currency can be received by clearing missions.

CP Shop
A new shop that uses CP as currency will be added. Chasers will be able to purchase a variety of items using their CP from this shop.

In-Game Cash Shop (KP Shop)
A new in-game cash shop will be added that uses a new Cash currency called KP will be added. This new shop will provide players with easy to use UI and also provide the option to try on certain items before purchase.

PVE Mode
All PVE missions will now be unified to 1 difficulty but will change difficulty depending on the mode being played.

PVE will be separated in to 2 categories: Group Mission and Daily Mission
Group Mission will focus on fighting random enemies with 3 to 4 party members and the Daily Dungeons will have a designated enemy you fight with 6 player teams on each day.

Item Modification
The item modification system will be removed. All weapon, costume and accessories will now have their Sub Stats removed due to this change and a new 'Ability Slot' will be added.

All Weapon and Costume will now have their stats to the max upgrade performance amount.
Weapons will now have all slots such as Karma Crystal and Sub Karma Crystal unlocked.

For items that already has its sub stats allocated, it will be changed to the highest stat in the new system.
Karma, Weapon and Outfits will also have the new stats applied to it after the update.

New Items

Magic Stone
A new item called Magic Stone will be added. This item will allow players to apply stats to Weapon and Costumes.

Settia Costume
Settia Costume will now be released for top and bottom pieces.

Gender Costumes
From now on, all costumes released for KurtzPel will be released for a set gender. All existing costumes can be worn regardless of gender.

Character Name Change Ticket
A new item that will allow players to change their character's name will be added.

Character Appearance Change Ticket
A new item that only changes your character's appearance will be added. This ticket cannot change the character's gender.

Basic Motion Change Item
LUA selection step will be removed from Character Creation and all characters will now have default motion set to the "JUDGE" LUA. Also, after the update, everyone will receive a cube item that will allow you to pick 1 basic motion of your choice.
This basic motion items will change your character's idle pose, idle motion, and also jump animation.

Extraction
You will now acquire different items from extracting your items. All existing Essence items will be removed and automatically exchanged to the new items.

New Extraction Items
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/941406b90f627fefae8b71a90321635c1b3ce373.jpg

Exchanged Items
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/1cccef46de4da4b5ad68291b48b079b47b8f3bd0.jpg

Synthesis
More synthesis options using the PVP "Probatio Mark" material will be added.
Monster Accessory, Dye, and Settia Accessories will be removed from Synthesis.
Items such as Lost Piece and Energy will be exchanged to CP.

Emote Items
All emotes will now bind to a specific character upon use. (Cannot be reversed)
All free emotes will automatically be bound to your characters and certain emotes acquired from Events, Purchase and etc. will need to be consumed and bound to a character before it can be used.

Removed System

Steam Inventory
Steam inventory will be no longer used. However, players will still be able to withdraw the remaining items inside their Steam Inventory.

Basic Stat Redistribution
In order to aid with balance, we will be removing the Basic Stat Redistribution function from the game. All Chasers will now be fixed to the 5/5/5/5/5 stats.

NPC Affinity System
The NPC tracking Affinity system will be removed. All affinity rewards will be sent to Chasers whoever unlocked the Karmas during the January 15th Maintenance. However, common affinity NPC items such as Ensher and Crim will not be given.

Supply Box
All existing Supply Box items will no longer be sold in the game. You can still use the remaining Supply Boxes.

Rebirth Ticket
The rebirth ticket will no longer be sold and basic stat redistribution function from rebirth will be removed. Chasers will still be able to use the remaining Rebirth Ticket.

All above changes can change due to development complications and when there is a change, we will notify you on the changes.

notes.title: October 10th Balance Revamp Patch Notes
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/JU-tpUyswvg
Attention, Chasers!

KurtzPel's Biggest Balance Revamp Ever! Check it out!


Common, Karma, Mode Balance

[Common]
[olist]
Rage Break system will be added.
You can use while in Rage. You can escape from attacks by using all your rage gauge.
Anti-Chase system will be added.
If you are hit through Chase 3 times or more within a certain duration, you will be dropped immediately in invincible state.
It will count chase attacks that happen in a short span (one attack) as 1 Chase attack.
Fixed hit box remaining sometimes after a loop state. (Blazing Fist’s LMB→ LMB→LMB→. →LMB~ etc.).
INT will affect max Mana less.
In relation, at All Stat=5 basic Mana for Sword Taliah/Dance of Wind/Blazing Fist/Dual Soul will increase while basic Mana for Diabolic Witch will decrease 
Detailed stats are as follows:

Balanced Stat Example (All Stat = 5)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/c870dc05d23b349b48536bee1c6587fcdd494f4e.png
Changed Stat Example (Sword Taliah/ Dance of Wind/Blazing Fist/ Dual Soul = STR & AGI 6/ INT 3, Diabolic Witch / Sacred Guardian= STR & AGI 4/ INT & WIS 6)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/d16460454d74656913549f1e000fb9effc1ceeee.png
[/olist]

[Sword Taliah][olist]
Overall, weapon range (not length, but width) has been slightly increased for a more stable combo.
Spin Attack (LMB→LMB→. →LMB~) is now easier to use (Start timing adjusted) and the enemy will be launched in the air at first hit.
During a loop, target hit will be stunned longer for a more stable combo.
Attack distance has been decreased to fit FX.
During RMB~, the time required to increase to max endurance has been decreased to 2/3.
You can continue the combo longer, as you can execute the basic 2 hit combo faster after Evade LMB preventing your target from Evading.
Storm Slash
- Attack Range is decreased. (-10%)
Fragment Strike
- No longer knockdown your target. Will stun for 1.5 sec. instead.
- Casting speed (duration from start to first hit) is decreased.
Stun Hit
- Endurance state is increased (+25%) and Endurance Break (+60%).
- Stun duration is increased to 2.4 sec. at Max level.
Land Demolisher
- Less likely to accidently activate additional attack after first hit due to button mashing.
Fortitude
- At Level 3, Damage and Endurance Break will decrease. (-50%, Like basic 1 hit combo)
[/olist]

[Dance of Wind][olist]
Bow flinch duration during RMB+LMB~ is decreased. (-50%)
Now Evade→LMB will not knockdown enemy. Instead, it will slightly launch them in the air so you can continue the combo.
Siege Mode
- Preparation stance will hit nearby opponent and launch them in the air. As such, preparation stance will now have Mana cost and cooldown.
- Auto target range is increased to make it easier to use in a combo.
- Charging duration decreased to allow bigger damage in the same amount of time.
- Push back the target further upon hit, and projectile size and flinch increase.
- You can Evade cancel quicker after firing.
- You can transition to standby motion quicker after last hit.
Salvo Arrows
- Max arrows number increased. (3 → 5)
- You can transition to standby motion quicker after last hit.
Raining Arrows
- Max duration increased, as such, total damage is also increased.
- Damage will increase up to stage 3 depending on the duration. The higher the level, the faster you reach stage 3 damage.
- The combo is less stable, as the target flinch duration is decreased.
[/olist]

[Diabolic Witch]
[olist]
Now all commands will be considered ‘Spells’
As such, ‘INT’ and Accessories ‘casting speed’ effects will also affect commands.
This also applies to the new Karma, ‘Sacred Guardian’.
Casting speed for Multi-Fireball combo in Midair + LMB→,→LMB~ is decreased. (this is connected to change #1 at standard stat = ALL 5, it will be the same as before.)
After midair combo, you can no longer use Meditation in the air when your ‘stamina<0’.
RMB+LMB~ fire ball size is increased.
Delay from ready stance to fire is decreased for Special Attack (RMB+LMB~Dash).
After RMB+LMB Hold Command Attacks, if you still hold RMB+LMB~, you can transition back to ready stance to use the Hold commands consecutively.
Among RMB+LMB Hold Command Attacks, lightning (RMB+LMB~Dash) will have a slow homing function for a short duration.
Among RMB+LMB Hold Command Attacks, Flame Wheel (back dash) damage is decreased. (-15%)
When it disappears after max hit, it will explode. Total damage is the same when you include the explosion damage.
Lightning
- Stun duration is adjusted. (1,2 hits =1 sec., 3 hits=2 sec.)
- Interval between 2nd and 3rd attack is longer.
Black Hole
- After casting, even when the castor cancels the spell with Evade, you can hold the target for the duration of the skill. (It doesn’t explode, but it will hold the target in place.)
- Castor can Evade cancel quicker after explosion.
- The higher the level, the longer the target is held by the black hole, but the casting speed will remain the same. (It will not become faster based on ‘INT’ or ‘casting speed’)
These changes have been made to focus and enhance on Black Hole’s crowd control function.
Mana Ray
- You can now change the up and down direction of the Mana Ray as well.
- You can enhance the ray effect to 3 even as a level 1,2 skill.
There will be a difference in the amount of time it requires to reach to Stage 3 effect.
- Mana cost increased.
Demonic Awakening
- Now Endurance Break increased for all attacks upon cast. (2.5 times)
- Skill Cooldown decrease effect increased. (Level 1 =2 times, Level 2=3 times, Level 3=4 times)
- Casting Speed decrease effect will increase for skills with a casting bar. (Level 1=2 times, Level 2=2.5 times, Level 3=3 times)
[/olist]

[Blazing Fist][olist]
During RMB~, the time required to increase to max endurance has been decreased to 2/3.
It is now less likely for the attack to hit random directions as the target range after Evade has increased.
You can no longer jump in certain areas while in RMB~ state.
Whirlwind
- You can no longer Evade.
- Max whirlwind duration decreased. (-1.5 sec)
- Whirlwind attack range increased.
- While it’s still short, the duration from cast to hit has slightly increased.
- Fixed error where grab doesn’t work upon hit at max range.
Reckless Charge
- Duration decreased.
- When charging towards the target, max strike range decreased.
- Fixed some of the cause of the error where the skill transitions to special state even upon hit instead of changing to grab.
Wild Flurry
- Low Kick that knockdown target, now has increased range.
Ultimate Heat
- It was redesigned to become an instant cast skill, instead of being a charging skill.
- Endurance and Endurance Break increased.
- It is now a 1 hit skill and will stun upon breaking Endurance.
- Stun duration is 2.5 sec. at max level.
Instant Chase
- Projectile range decreased. (-7%)
- Projectile speed increased. (+7%)
Devoted Awakening
- Moving Speed and Endurance increased. (+50%)
- While in Devoted Awakening state, activate chain lift attack immediately by entering dash, right after ‘Evade Attack’, ‘Grab Fail’ ‘Last attack of Basic Combo’ and ‘Basic Multi-Hit combo’. 
[/olist]

[Dual Soul]
[olist]
Improved situation where evade attack doesn’t work when pressing directional key with LMB, by increasing the transition time to moving immediately after Evade.
The height in which the target is launched with Evade attack is slightly increased. Afterwards, you can transition to a basic 2 hit combo faster.
Evade Moon Slash damage has overall decreased. (-50%)
Pre-input timing is improved and starting timing is decreased to using Moon Slash more smoothly with Dash after successful attack with Flash Cut with 1 Charging or more.
During RMB~, the time required to increase to max endurance has been decreased to 2/3.
No charge Flash Cut damage decreased. (-50%)
Midair attack stamina cost increased. (It will be at a similar rate to Dance of Wind)
Fixed where Moon Slash will occasionally fly abnormally high. The motion stopping after a certain duration when using Moon Slash from a high location has been fixed.
Height and distance of the target launched by the dash attack is decreased. Due to this, the interval in which you can input the Chase attack has also decreased.
Spinning Strike
- Hit range decreased.
- Stun duration increased. (Level 2=2 sec., Level 3=2.4 sec.)
Critical Slash
- Hit range decreased.
- 2nd moving hit will no longer launch or knockdown.
Destiny’s Restraints
- Combo is now more stable as the initial hit will not always continue to the later attacks, or when the later attacks hit, it will hit until the end of the skill. 
[/olist]

[Sacred Guardian]
Thank you everyone for your valuable feedback for our October 5th 3rd Eltheca Proving Ground.
Your feedback will be implemented for the October 10th Update.
Just to discuss a few, we will be removing the stun function from the basic combo and tweaking the damage and hit box of Command and Skills, as well as decreasing the heal amount.

Find out more on the Sacred Guardian Karma on the Live Server on October 10th 2019!


All above changes can change due to development complications and when there is a change, we will notify you on the changes.

notes.title: September 10th Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=GXioQJUoNEU;full][/previewyoutube]
Attention, Chasers!

Please check this week’s maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) September 10th,2019 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/3b6d550e3704723322351c26a90ffbf01a90b1fd.png
(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

Additional Content and System Update
1. Synthesis System will be added.

‘Hildad’s Cube’ placed inside Eltheca Library will allow you to synthesize items and extract ingredients from existing items.
While playing PVE missions, you will have a chance to acquire Energy of Chaos and Lost Pieces that can be used to synthesize boss items.
While playing PVP missions, you will have a chance to acquire Energy of Harmony and you can use Essence items that you acquire from extraction to craft Supply Box items and Karma Crystals.
Essence item type will depend on the item you are extracting from. (Example: If you extract an accessory, you will acquire Accessory Essence)
The number of energy and essence for synthesis will depend on the number & type of item.
You can craft either Energy of Harmony or Chaos by using a 2: 1 Ratio, 2 being the ingredient and 1 being the target energy you are trying to synthesize.
You will be able to synthesize Basic Dye to create Intermediate Dye and you will be able to use Intermediate Dye to create Advanced Dye.
(※ We implemented the Synthesis System in order for players to depend less on RNG to acquire the item they want from a certain boss. With the new system, players will be able to make sure they acquire the item they need while not heavily depending on RNG.)

2. Sub Karma Crystal System will be changed.

From now on, Sub Karma Crystal will no longer depend on which slot it is equipped on and will apply its effect on the Karma (Weapon). With this change, the existing Sub Karma Crystal has been changed.
You will no longer be able to equip the same Sub Karma Crystal on the same Karma (Weapon).
New Sub Karma Crystals has been added.
Weapon’s Modification count will be increased by 1.
You can now acquire new Sub Karma Crystals from the Synthesis System.

3. Phase 1 of Guild System has been updated. You will now be able to create and join guilds.

Guild Menu can be accessed by pressing the R button and pressing the button beside the Friend Icon.
Guild Names can only consist of Alphabet and Numbers. The length can be from 4 to 16 characters.
You require 10,000 CP in order to create a guild.
Your guild can have up to 50 members.
When you are in a guild, you will be able to chat with your members by using the Guild Chat function.
You can also join a guild from the Recommended Guild list.
10% of AP earned by your guild members will be added to the Guild’s GAP.
(This will not decrease the amount of AP earned by guild members.)
Depending on the earned GAP, the guild ranking will be set and depending on the ranking, this guild will be placed on the top of the recommended guild list.
GAP will reset on the 1st of Each Month @ 06:00 (Server Time).
Guild Master and Guild Members who hasn’t logged in for 30 days will be kicked from the guild.
If the Guild Master disbands the guild or guild member quits the guild or gets kicked from a guild, all character in that account won’t be able to join another guild for 24 hours.
Phase 2 of Guild System Update will include Guild Only Eltheca Channel and content that can use the GAP.
4. 6 Player PVE Mission, “Blazing Blade of Calamity” will be added.

One day, a Knight of Calamity appeared who wielded the power of Calamity at his will. 
The Chase dispatched their members to investigate this issue but due to losing so many of their members, they decided to only allow Chasers with D Rank or higher in order to minimize casualties.
Blazing Blade of Calamity will not only depend on each individual Chaser’s abilities but also team work.
Knight of Calamity has a total of 4 phases and each phase has a time limit. 
If you are not able to pass each Phase within a set time limit, you will fail the mission. You will also acquire rewards depending on the number of phases you were able to clear.
※	Reward Per Phase
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a81824c625e2db238c760f8aeccded3e71cbeb15.png
Acquired item can be extracted and synthesized to a different item.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a4c38dc2f34565685f95d938a1b6cdd22ce336a8.png

5. Max number of party member has been increased to 6.

Depending on the number of members in your party, missions you can request for will be limited.
When there are 3 members in your party, you will be able to queue up for Practice Probatio.
When there are 4 members in your party, you will be able to queue up 4 Player PVE Missions.
When there are 6 members in your party, you will be able to queue up 6 Player PVE Missions.
(※ We have heard your complaints about the limitations of current party system and with the addition of the 6 Player PVE mission ‘Blazing Blade of Calamity’, we realized that it could be too difficult for randomly matched players to clear. This is why we decided to increase the current party size to 6. Also, with the addition of the guild system, we hope many guild members play together.)

6. You will now be able to choose 2 maps you do not prefer for Official and Practice Probatio.

 When you select 2 maps that you display, it won’t be matched in your matchmaking queue. However, depending on the players you are matched with, if there aren’t enough players, you may be matched to a map you disliked. (While in a party, only the map preference of the party leader will be in effect.)
 Characters that has less than 5 total matches from Probatio (Official & Practice) won’t be able to use this function.

7. Survival Mode can now start with fewer players (9 Players).

 The max members are still 18 players but while matchmaking, if 9 or more players agree to start the match, the match will start regardless if the 10th member accepts or declines.
Also, if a certain duration passes for matchmaking, the match will start with 9 or more players.


8. Localization for French has been improved.

9. Trickster Elemental, Settia's Invisible Accessories will be added.

Settia's blesses the accessories with her power and make the accessories invisible.
You can craft these accessories from Hildad's Cube by using Essence and Energy.

10. Matchmaking Change

 When matchmaking for Survival Mode, accounts that are E Rank and have less than 5 match history will be put in a separate queue. Other players will have the same matchmaking process.
 When you are in a party, if your party member’s rank is higher than you by 5 or higher, the matchmaking will be made according to the higher-ranking character’s bracket. (If the difference is less than 5, party rating will take effect.)
 We are reducing the max rank difference to 15 ranks. (Example: Depending on the matchmaking time, D1 rank can meet up to B5 rank.)

11. PVE Mission cooldowns will be removed.

12. Prerequisite Missions will be added in order to access ‘Illusion Device Overload’ & ‘Chase: Illusion Core’.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/4456a6c80fb366082b43357edc69ab50ff840219.jpg

Shop Update
1. Karma Crystal and Sub Karma Crystals will be removed from Supply Boxes.
Due to the above change, the drop rates have been changed like following.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/245a85326d6acbc773ef16a71798b6472cd379be.png

2. The ‘Gold Lion Cape’ will now drop from Supply Box (Karma) instead of Supply Box (Costume)

3. New Premium Items added on September 10th will be notified with a separate announcement. 

4. Blazing Fist & Diabolic Witch DLC compensation will end on UTC+0 Sep 10th 00:00.


Event
1. Hildad's Earring can be crafted  starts

 Duration: 2019.09.10 After Maintenance ~ 2019.09.25 Before Maintenance
 Remain Hildad's lost pieces will be deleted on 2019.09.25 during Maintenance
 Hildad's Earring cannot be trade


Bug Fix
1. When your character falls or leaves the map area, you will be returned to the game instead of being stuck there.

If your deliver the killing blow to your enemies, your HP will be recovered and you will receive a buff that increases your attack power.

notes.notes:

Additional Content and System Update
1. First Official Probatio Season has commenced. 
    Season 1 will start 08/07 After Maintenance ~ 11/06 Before Maintenance.
    During the season, you can increase Season Level.
    Season Level can be increased by completing the new ‘Challenge’ system. You will be able to receive rewards every time you reach a certain level.
